title: Transportation Tracker - OTR Operations
description:
AJG Transport is expanding its route operations division and seeking a reliable, detail-oriented professional to help support and streamline our daily transportation duties. We are looking for a Transportation Tracker to support real time fleet movement, manage load data accuracy, and ensure smooth coordination between drivers, customers, and internal teams.



Role Overview

You will serve as a real time control point within route operations. Your responsibility is to ensure loads are properly assigned, tracked, updated, and documented while maintaining consistent communication across drivers, brokers, and customers. You will operate within structured SOPs while making fast, sound operational decisions when challenges arise.



What You’ll Be Doing

• Monitor lanes, driver movement, load progress, ETAs, and service requirements using GPS and TMS.

• Assign and dispatch loads based on driver availability, Hours of Service, customer requirements, and operational priorities.

• Maintain accurate real-time load data, check calls, timestamps, delivery milestones, and documentation in TMS and Google Sheets.

• Communicate with drivers, brokers, and customers while proactively addressing delays, route conflicts, detention risks, and other service issues.

• Follow established dispatch and escalation SOPs, provide clear shift reports and handoffs, and escalate operational risks to leadership as needed.



What Success Looks Like

• Monitor lanes and critical loads with urgency, accuracy, and consistency from start to finish.

• Maintain complete, accurate, and up-to-date information across TMS, Google Sheets, and tracking platforms.

• Provide scheduled updates on time with clear, concise, and actionable communication.

• Identify and escalate operational risks early, bringing solutions and next steps whenever possible.

• Maintain smooth and well-documented shift handoffs, and demonstrate reliability during high-pressure situations.



Who We’re Looking For

• Experience in logistics, freight brokerage, dispatch, transportation tracking, or similar operations, with an understanding of fleet coordination, load planning, and Hours of Service.

• Ability to monitor multiple loads and drivers simultaneously while maintaining accuracy, urgency, and proper prioritization in a live dispatch environment.

• Strong written and verbal communication skills across Zoom, chat, and
, with a minimum typing speed of 45 WPM.

• Highly detail-oriented with sound judgment, strong follow-through, and the ability to operate effectively in high-volume communication environments.

• Team oriented, coachable, and dependable, with a willingness to follow established processes, accept feedback, and collaborate without resistance or ego.



Why Join AJG Transport?

• Permanent remote opportunity with a stable, long-term setup.

• Structured systems, clear expectations, and defined performance KPIs.

• Hands-on leadership with direct feedback, coaching, and support.

• Measurable growth opportunities within a scaling freight brokerage.

• Performance recognition with advancement potential for strong contributors.



Schedule & Work Setup

• Direct hire, full time position with a US based company, and permanent work from home setup.

• Available shift: Friday - Tuesday 10 PM - 8 AM CDT | Monday - Saturday 7 PM - 5 AM CDT

• Zoom presence with camera on and audio unmuted is required throughout the scheduled shift.

• Time tracking software is used for accountability and performance support.



If you thrive in fast moving transportation operations, understand the importance of real-time coordination, and can execute lanes with precision under pressure, we want to hear from you.

title: Track & Trace Assistant – Quality Assurance
description:
GH Logistics is a growing freight brokerage and asset based logistics company specializing in dry van and reefer freight. Our team is built on strong systems, clear communication, and reliable execution. As we continue to scale nationally, we are looking for a Track & Trace Assistant – Quality Assurance to help ensure that every load is verified, compliant, and properly tracked before it moves.



If you’re someone who notices the small details, enjoys organized processes, and takes pride in preventing problems before they happen this role may be a great fit.



Role Overview

Your work directly prevents missed pickups, tracking gaps, compliance issues, and communication breakdowns while collaborating closely with Operations, Sales, and Management to ensure loads move smoothly and safely with clear SOPs, structured workflows, and strong team support to help you succeed.



What You’ll Be Doing

• Review next day loads before execution

• Verify driver details (name, phone number, reachability)

• Confirm CDL validity and compliance

• Assign and confirm active tracking (FourKites and/or Samsara)

• Call drivers/carriers to confirm pickup and delivery details, appointment times, and equipment requirements

• Download and upload customer tenders when applicable

• Ensure load information is accurate in the TMS and QA trackers

• Document findings clearly and consistently

• Escalate issues when something does not meet standards

• Maintain organized records and support process improvements



What Success Looks Like

• All next day loads are reviewed before execution

• Tracking is active and confirmed

• Potential issues are caught early

• Documentation is clear and organized

• Escalations are timely and professional



Who We’re Looking For

• Have experience in US. logistics, freight, tracking, quality assurance, or operational audit

• Are comfortable auditing details and verifying information

• Understand that small details prevent big operational problems

• Follow SOPs consistently

• Communicate clearly with drivers and internal teams

• Stay organized while handling multiple tasks

• Work well independently in a structured remote environment

• Are open to feedback and continuous improvement

• Have strong written and verbal English skills

• Type at least 50 WPM



Work Setup & Schedule

• Full Time Remote Role| Direct Hire to US Company

• Current Shift Availability: Saturday - Wednesday 8 AM - 5 PM CDT | Friday - Tuesday 10 AM - 7 PM CDT

• Zoom presence (with camera open) required

• Time tracking software used for accountability and performance support



What You'll Get

• Independent Contractor Setup

• $75 monthly insurance stipend (eligibility begins 30 days after hire)

• Paid biweekly. No delayed payments and no excuses.

• Stable & long-term position. This is not project-based nor seasonal. We're building a team and we need people who want to build with us.

• Direct access to US executive leadership. You're not buried in a call center reporting to a middle manager. You work directly with our operations team.

• Real operations work.



If you take pride in doing things right and preventing issues before they happen, we’d love to hear from you.

title: Developer Advocate - Service Management
Trailer Management Admin
description:
GH Logistics (AJG Transport) is a high performance freight brokerage and asset based logistics company specializing in dry van and refrigerated freight. We move quickly, but we move with structure. Our operation is built on real-time visibility, disciplined execution, and clear communication. We take pride in keeping freight organized, assets accounted for, and operations running cleanly from pickup to delivery.



If you’re someone who enjoys structured execution, asset visibility, and maintaining operational accuracy behind the scenes, you’ll feel right at home here.



Role Overview

You support the Trailer Manager in overseeing a fleet of 1000+ trailers across multiple carriers and terminals. You play a critical role in ensuring every trailer is accounted for, properly assigned, compliant, and operational. This is not a passive data-entry role. You’re the person who keeps the fleet picture accurate, coordinates trailer repair concerns, and flags problems before they cost us time and money.



You should be familiar with common trailer repair and maintenance issues and understand how to coordinate practical solutions with drivers, terminals, vendors, and maintenance teams. If you thrive on structure, take pride in clean records, and don’t let things slip through the cracks, this role was built for you.



What You’ll Be Doing

• Monitor, update, and reconcile trailer locations across the network on a daily basis

• Coordinate with route supervisors, internal team, dispatchers, carriers, drivers, and terminals to ensure accurate trailer assignments and timely movement

• Track trailer availability, maintenance schedules, and repair status

• Identify trailer issues, assess their operational impact, and coordinate the appropriate repair solution

• Maintain accurate and up-to-date trailer documentation (registrations, inspections, tags, insurance)

• Support reporting on trailer utilization, downtime, and compliance

• Identify discrepancies, missing updates, or unreported trailer statuses and escalate promptly

• Assist in improving internal trailer tracking systems for better visibility and accuracy

• Execute processes consistently with strong attention to detail

• Collaborate cross-functionally with dispatch, compliance, and maintenance teams



What Success Looks Like

• Trailer locations and statuses are consistently accurate and fully reconciled

• Assignments, availability, and movements are properly documented and updated in real time

• Maintenance, repair, and compliance records are complete and up to date

• Trailer defects and repair needs are identified early, properly communicated, and resolved efficiently

• Discrepancies are identified early and resolved before impacting operations

• Reporting on utilization and downtime is clean, accurate, and actionable

• Communication across departments is clear, timely, and structured



Who We’re Looking For

• Experience in fleet management, trailer maintenance coordination, logistics coordination, truck or trailer repairs, dispatch, or similar live operational roles (not general admin work)

• Familiarity with common dry van and refrigerated trailer repairs, defects, and maintenance concerns

• Ability to understand trailer repair issues, determine the appropriate next steps, and coordinate solutions

• Knowledge of common trailer components and issues, such as tires, brakes, lights, doors, landing gear, air lines, electrical systems, refrigeration units, and structural damage, is strongly preferred

• Strong attention to detail with high accuracy in tracking and record-keeping

• Organized and capable of managing multiple data points across systems and teams

• Clear and professional communication skills across departments

• Familiarity with platforms such as Samsara, LoadStop, or similar tracking systems is a plus

• Proactive mindset, able to identify and address issues before they escalate

• Strong analytical, troubleshooting, and problem-solving skills in a fast-paced environment

• Minimum 45 WPM typing speed

• Proficient in Microsoft Office, Google Workspace, and Logistics tools

• Reliable internet connection and fully equipped remote work setup

• Team oriented, coachable, and aligned with structured processes



Schedule & Work Setup

• Full time permanent remote role

• Direct Hire to a US Company (not agency or BPO)

• Current needed shifts: Tuesday - Saturday 8 PM - 6 AM CDT

• Reliable home office setup and back up internet and power stations

• Zoom presence required (camera on throughout shift)

• Hubstaff time tracking during shifts.



What You'll Get

• Independent Contractor Setup

• $75 monthly insurance stipend (eligibility begins 30 days after hire)

• Paid biweekly. No delayed payments and no excuses.

• Stable & long-term position. This is not project-based nor seasonal. We're building a team and we need people who want to build with us.

• Direct access to US executive leadership. You're not buried in a call center reporting to a middle manager. You work directly with our operations team.

• Real operations work.



Who Thrives Here

• People who've worked in a US freight brokerage or 3PL and want something more stable

• Former fleet coordinators, logistics admins, or dispatch support staff who are tired of BPO environments

• Fleet admins who take ownership. You don't clock in and zone out. You manage trailers like they are your business.

• People who can recognize trailer issues, coordinate repairs, follow up consistently, and ensure equipment returns to service as quickly as possible

• People who want to grow into leadership but need the right company to do it in.



Who This Isn't For

• General VAs looking for easy remote work. This is real logistics and not admin tasks.

• People who need constant supervision or step by step instructions for every task

• Anyone who can't commit to US shift hours consistently

• Candidates without actual freight/logistics experience. We don't have time to teach the basics.

• Candidates who are unfamiliar with trailer maintenance concerns or are uncomfortable coordinating repairs and operational solutions



This role is built for someone who takes pride in maintaining control over moving assets, ensuring trailers are accounted for, properly assigned, properly repaired, and always operational. If you value structure, accuracy, problem-solving, and keeping operations running clean behind the scenes, you’ll thrive in this role.

title: Video Editor, Short-Form Social and Paid Ads (US Consumer Brand)
description:
sideo Editor, Short-Form Social and Paid Ads (US Consumer Brand)

Type of Work: Part Time



Wage/Salary: $6-$7.50 USD per hour ($
per month at 30 hours a week). 

Hours per Week: 30, with the option to increase to 40



Skills: Video Editing, CapCut, Short-Form Video, TikTok,
 Ads, YouTube Editing, Motion Graphics, Captioning



Job Description:



HeartStamp is a US brand that helps people create personalized greeting cards. Customers can have them printed and mailed, or send them digitally, and we also do invitations and gifts. We're heading into Christmas, our busiest season, and we need a fast, reliable video editor who can start right away. You'll turn raw footage into short-form videos and ads that people watch all the way through, every working day.



What you'll do:



-Edit short vertical videos for TikTok, Instagram Reels, YouTube Shorts and Pinterest. This includes our card-opening videos, filmed by our team and handed to you with direction.

-Edit creator (UGC) footage to written notes: trims, pacing, captions, on-screen text and brand graphics.

-Build paid ads from multiple sources, including UGC, B-roll, product shots and screen recordings.

-Turn one winning ad into a batch of testable versions with new hooks in the first 2 to 3 seconds, different pacing, captions, text overlays and calls to action.

-Re-cut ads for each platform's size, length and safe zones, and quickly refresh ads that are wearing out with a new intro, trim or overlay.

-Burn in captions for sound-off viewing, and place animated callouts and graphics from our in-house kit.

-Edit YouTube and tutorial videos and brand sizzle reels, including product walkthroughs recorded from our website and iPhone app.

-After we train you on our tools, produce short generative video clips and light motion graphics for our website.

Keep a tidy, tagged footage library so every new version is fast to build.



Must have:

-3+ years editing short-form vertical video for brands, with work you can link to.

-A real feel for hooks. You know the first two seconds d
 whether anyone keeps watching.

CapCut fluency. We provide CapCut. Premiere Pro, DaVinci Resolve or After Effects on your own license is a plus.

-Strong written English, quick replies on Slack, and a written daily standup every working day.

-Availability for our daily overlap: Monday to Friday, 11:00 AM to 2:00 PM US Eastern. That's 11:00 PM to 2:00 AM Philippine time now, and 12:00 AM to 3:00 AM from November 1.

-A computer that renders 1080p and 4K without struggling, stable internet, and a backup plan for brownouts.



Nice to have:

-Paid social experience on Meta or TikTok, including cutting ad variations for testing.

-Experience with generative video tools such as Runway, Kling, Veo or Seedance.

-Motion graphics or animated website elements.

-Past work for family, gifting or e-commerce brands.



How we work: Our Social Media Manager and Paid Ads lead will direct your day-to-day work, and our founder gives final approval. Everything runs on written briefs in Notion and Slack. If a brief is unclear, ask before guessing.



How to apply: Every hire starts with a short paid test at your hourly rate. Please send:



-The words HOOK FIRST at the top of your application. We skip applications without them.

-3 to 5 links to short-form vertical videos you edited (TikTok, Reels, YouTube, Vimeo or a portfolio site), with one line on what you did for each.

If you have cut ad variations, one original ad and two versions you made from it.

-Your earliest start date, and confirmation that the 11:00 AM to 2:00 PM US Eastern overlap works for you.

-The editing software you use now.

title: Executive Assistant – Investor Outreach & Appointment Setting (Full-Time, Remote, US Eastern Time)
description:
About us



King Holdings is a family office based in Atlanta, Georgia, with a real estate portfolio across the Southeastern US. We are raising capital for King Fund III LP, a private investment fund. Our team is small and works quickly, and we need an organized assistant to keep our investor outreach running day to day.



The role



You will report directly to our Director of Capital Markets. You will support outreach to family offices and other accredited investors, including making outbound calls to book introductory meetings with our senior team. This is an appointment-setting and support role. You will follow an approved script, and you will not discuss investment terms or give investment advice.



What you’ll do



Make 50–80 outbound calls per day to family offices and investment professionals, using an approved script. The goal of each call is to book a 20-minute intro call with our senior team.



Leave voi
s and log every call outcome and note in Close CRM on the same day. Pass any questions about the fund itself to our team.



Build and enrich prospect lists in Apollo.io and Excel. This means checking names, titles,
s, and LinkedIn profiles for accuracy.



Keep the CRM clean. Log activity, update contact stages, and flag duplicates and bad data.



Manage LinkedIn connection requests and inbox follow-ups using approved message templates.



Schedule intro calls across time zones, and send calendar invites and reminders.



Monitor shared inboxes, sort replies, and send interested leads to the right person the same day.



Support cold
 campaigns in Instantly. This includes uploading lists, monitoring bounces, and reporting results.



Prepare a short weekly report on call activity, meetings booked, and pipeline status.



Handle general admin work as needed, including document formatting, research, and file organization.



What we’re looking for



At least 2 years of experience as an executive assistant, virtual assistant, or appointment setter, ideally supporting US-based 

finance, real estate, or B2B sales teams



At least 1 year of outbound calling experience for US clients



A clear, neutral English accent and a calm, professional manner on the phone. You will be speaking with senior executives.



Excellent written English. Every message has to be clean and professional.



Hands-on experience with at least one CRM, such as Close, HubSpot, or Salesforce, and with Apollo.io or a similar prospecting tool

Strong skills in Excel or Google Sheets



Comfort hearing “no” many times a day while keeping a high standard on every call



Close attention to detail. You check your work before you send it.



Reliable internet, a backup power source, a quiet workspace, and a USB headset with a noise-canceling microphone



Ability to keep information confidential



Nice to have



Experience calling into finance, real estate, or wealth management



Experience with LinkedIn Sales Navigator or Instantly



Familiarity with US private equity, real estate, or wealth management



Schedule and pay



Full-time, 40 hours per week, Monday to Friday



Hours: [9:00 AM–5:00 PM US Eastern Time], which is [9:00 PM–5:00 AM Philippine Time]



Pay: 6 USD/Hour with a bonus per qualified meeting held.



Long-term position with room to grow



How to apply



Start your application with the words “Fund Outreach” so we know you read the full posting. Then include the following:



Your resume



A short paragraph, no more than 150 words, about your cold calling experience. Tell us who you called, how many calls you made per day, and your meeting-booked rate.



A list of the tools you’ve used



A voice recording of 60 seconds or less, introducing yourself as if you were calling a US business owner. A Vocaroo or Google Drive link is fine.



We will not review applications that are missing any of these items.

title: US Tax Preparer (1040/1065/1120-S/1120) - Drake - CPA-Led US Firm - Part-Time, Full-Time in Tax Season
description:
ABOUT US

Prime & Ledger CPAs is a US CPA firm (Arkansas) serving small businesses nationwide - especially restaurants, salons and their owners. The firm is led by a CPA with Big Four and large-corporate tax experience. We prepare individual, partnership, S corporation and C corporation returns, plus FICA tip credit (IRC Section 45B) amended returns.



We work differently from most firms: we built our own tax preparation software ("P&L") that imports last year's return, bulk-imports client data, computes the return, and reconciles it against Drake Tax before filing. You will be trained on it. We want someone who wants to work accurately and efficiently with good tools - not someone who wants to key every number by hand.



SCHEDULE AND PAY

- Part-time (about 4 hours/day) year-round, moving to full-time (8 hours/day) January 15 - April 30 and August 15 - October 15.

- $7 - $10 per hour depending on experience and test results (about $600 - $900/month part-time; $1,200 - $1,800/month full-time in season). Raises for accuracy and turnaround.

- Flexible hours, but you must overlap at least 4 hours daily with US Central Time (e.g., 8:00 AM - 12:00 PM CT = 9:00 PM - 1:00 AM Philippine time).



WHAT YOU WILL DO

- Import prior-year returns into our software and verify every extracted line and carryforward (capital loss, passive loss, QBI, Section 179, NOL).

- Organize client documents and bulk-import W-2s, 1099s, K-1s, 1098s, trial balances and payroll data.

- Prepare Forms 1040 (Schedules A, B, C, D/8949, E, SE), 1065, 1120-S and 1120, including K-1s, depreciation (Form 4562) and state returns.

- Reconcile each return in our software to Drake Tax line by line, explain every difference, and clear Drake diagnostics and e-file messages.

- Compare each return to the prior year and explain significant changes.

- Write clear review notes for the CPA reviewer and resolve review comments promptly.

- Draft open-items lists for clients (no direct client contact unless asked).

- Off-season: bookkeeping clean-up, payroll reports for FICA tip credit analysis, and extensions.



MUST HAVE

- At least 2 full US tax seasons PREPARING returns (not only data entry) for a US CPA or EA firm.

- Hands-on experience with Form 1040 AND at least one of Form 1065 or 1120-S.

- Professional tax software experience. Drake strongly preferred; UltraTax, Lacerte, ProSeries, ProConnect or CCH accepted.

- Solid understanding of K-1s, basis, depreciation, and Schedule C/E reporting.

- Excellent written English; comfortable following checklists and written procedures.

- Reliable internet with backup power (UPS or generator) and a quiet, private workspace.

- A US PTIN, or willingness to obtain one when hired.

- Willing to sign an NDA, confidentiality and data-protection agreements, and provide an NBI clearance.



NICE TO HAVE

- Philippine CPA, or US EA / CPA candidate.

- Restaurant, salon or hospitality clients; payroll registers; Form 8846 (FICA tip credit).

- Multi-state returns, BBA partnership rules, Form 7203.

- QuickBooks Online or Xero.



SECURITY (NON-NEGOTIABLE)

You will work only inside our secure remote environment. No client data on personal devices, no downloads, no screenshots, no copying files outside our systems. Access is monitored. These rules protect our clients under US federal law (IRC Section 7216).



HOW WE HIRE

1. Apply using the instructions below.

2. Short video call (20 minutes).

3. PAID test: prepare a sample return with planted issues in our software and Drake, then write review notes.

4. 30-day paid trial, then a long-term role.



HOW TO APPLY (follow exactly or your application will not be reviewed)

Start your application with "P&L Tax Season Ready" and answer:

1. How many US tax seasons have you worked, for what type of firm, and which return types did you prepare yourself?

2. Which tax software have you used, and for how many seasons? If Drake, which years?

3. Describe one difficult return you prepared and how you resolved the issue.

4. Do you have a PTIN? Will you get one if hired?

5. Your expected hourly rate, and whether you can work full-time January 15 - April 30.

title: Senior Accounts Payable Officer
description:
Who is Bare?



Bare is one of Australia’s fastest growing businesses, in one of the most traditional industries in the world — the funeral industry.



We exist to make end-of-life care accessible, affordable and transparent, changing the way Australians deal with death. For too long, the industry has delivered expensive, traditional, cookie-cutter services that don’t reflect how modern Australians want to say goodbye.



By combining empathy with technology, we’re creating end-of-life experiences that are simple, personalised and affordable. In just five years, we’ve supported more than 40,000 families, become Australia’s most awarded end-of-life provider (recognised for customer service, innovation and digital disruption), and built a team of 100+ passionate people.



And we’re just getting started.



As part of our continued growth, we’re looking for a Senior Accounts Payable Officer to join our finance team.



So, what’s the role?



We are looking for a detail-oriented and reliable Senior Accounts Payable Officer to join our finance team and support the day-to-day accounts payable operations of an Australian company.



The successful candidate will be responsible for accurately processing supplier invoices, maintaining vendor accounts, reconciling transactions, and ensuring payments are processed accurately and on time. The role will primarily use Dext and Xero will work closely with the Australian finance and operations teams.



This is an excellent opportunity for someone with strong attention to detail who enjoys working with numbers, following and improving processes, and maintaining accurate financial records.



What you'll do

-Process and code supplier invoices accurately in Dext and Xero

-Organize scheduled payments and prepare them for approval

-Handle urgent payments through Airwallex

-Respond to supplier queries and collaborate with the team on Slack

-Support month-end tasks and share ideas for improving how we work



What we're looking for

-3+ years in AP or a similar finance role

-Experience in supporting Australian businesses

-Experience with Xero and Dext

-Strong attention to detail, with the ability to work quickly and accurately

-Reliable, organized, and takes ownership of their work

-Clear written English

-Bonus: experience improving or automating finance processes



What’s in it for you?



This isn’t your ordinary finance role, in your ordinary company. You’ll join an entrepreneurial, inclusive culture where we succeed together. We offer autonomy, flexibility and real ownership. No two days are the same — and that’s exactly how we like it.



In addition, we offer:



-Strong opportunities for career growth and progression

-A high-performing and highly engaged team environment

-Autonomy and flexibility, including work-from-home options

-A competitive remuneration package

-The opportunity to help transform an industry and make a real human impact



The main reason you’ll join, however, is because you believe in what we’re building. You’re excited by growth. You want to help scale a business that is genuinely changing lives — and you want your finance expertise to be part of that journey.



Please include your resume in your application. Thank you!

title: Service Manager
description:
Position Overview

We are looking for an experienced, highly organized, and customer-focused Service Manager to oversee the daily operations of our service department.



The Service Manager will be responsible for managing service requests, supervising and coordinating technicians, overseeing scheduling and dispatching, resolving customer concerns, and ensuring that all service calls are handled efficiently and professionally.

The ideal candidate should have strong leadership, communication, problem-solving, and organizational skills. This position requires someone who can take ownership of service operations, make decisions independently, manage multiple priorities, and ensure that customers receive timely and reliable service.



Key Responsibilities

Service Operations & Management

- Oversee the daily operations of service department.

- Manage incoming service requests and ensure they are handled promptly and efficiently.

- Monitor open service tickets, pending repairs, and unresolved customer issues.

- Ensure service calls are properly documented, updated, and followed through until completion.

- Prioritize urgent service requests and manage escalations.

- Identify operational issues and implement improvements to increase efficiency and customer satisfaction.

- Ensure service department processes and procedures are consistently followed.

- Coordinate with technical support team regarding troubleshooting, equipment errors, and repair recommendations.



Technician Management & Coordination

- Oversee technician scheduling and dispatching.

- Assign service calls based on technician availability, location, and technical requirements.

- Follow up with technicians regarding service updates, diagnoses, parts recommendations, and repair status.

- Ensure technicians provide accurate and complete service rundowns.

- Address scheduling conflicts, technician delays, and other service-related challenges.



Customer Service & Escalation Management

- Serve as the main point of contact for complex or unresolved service issues.

- Provide customers with timely updates regarding service appointments, repairs, and pending parts.

- Maintain strong customer relationships through clear communication and consistent follow-ups.

- Take ownership of difficult service situations and ensure proper follow-through.



Reporting & Administrative Responsibilities

- Maintain accurate service records, customer information, and ticket updates.

- Monitor service department performance, including open tickets, response times, and pending repairs.

- Prepare service updates and reports for management as needed.

- Identify recurring service issues and recommend solutions to improve operations.



Qualifications

- Minimum of 2 years of experience in service management, service coordination, dispatching, technical support operations, or a similar role.

- Previous experience supervising or managing a service team is strongly preferred.

- Excellent verbal and written English communication skills.

- Strong leadership, decision-making, and problem-solving abilities.

- Ability to handle customer escalations and difficult situations professionally.

- Strong organizational skills with the ability to manage multiple service requests and priorities.

- Ability to work independently, take initiative, and make sound decisions.

- Customer-focused mindset with strong relationship management skills.



Why Join Us?

Stable Company: We have been in business for over a decade and continue to grow.

Leadership Opportunity: Take on a key management role and help oversee and improve our service department.

Career Growth: Work with an established company that values initiative, leadership, and long-term professional development.

Long-Term Opportunity: We are looking for a reliable and dedicated individual who wants to build a lasting career with our company.



Work Requirements

Since this is a remote position, applicants must have:

- Reliable high-speed internet connection.

- Reliable power supply; backup power is strongly preferred.

- Noise-canceling headset for professional call quality.

- Dedicated workspace with minimal background noise.

- Comfortable using
, CRM/service management systems, and other online tools.

- Ability to manage a team and coordinate service operations remotely.



How to Apply

Please submit the following:

1. Updated Resume – Highlight your experience in service management, team leadership, customer service, dispatching, and technical service operations.

2. Introduction Video or Vocaroo Voice Recording – Briefly introduce yourself and explain your experience managing service operations, handling customer escalations, and leading a team.

Applications without the required information may not be considered.



Ready to Join Our Team?

If you are an experienced, organized, and results-driven professional who enjoys leading teams, solving problems, and ensuring excellent customer service, we would love to hear from you!



Apply now and take the next step in your career as our Service Manager!

title: Join Our Team: Long-Term SEO Website Builder (Full-Time, Flexible Hours, Paid Training)
description:
Want a long-term home with a team that trusts you and wants to grow with you? You'll join our team and build lead-generating websites for local home service businesses using an easy drag-and-drop builder. No coding is needed. You'll use AI tools to create the content and images, and a step-by-step checklist guides every site you build. We are looking for someone to grow with us for the long-term.



About Us

We're a fully remote team of 5 (3 in the US, 2 in the Philippines). Together, we've launched over 36 sites in the last 3 months, building local SEO websites for home service businesses. We've kept everyone on the team since we started. We put high trust in our people to work hard, so we don't micromanage. You won't be working alone: you'll be a real part of the team, and we win together. We believe in paying fairly, training properly, and growing together.



What a "Site" Means for Us

Each site includes 12 pages:

- 1 home page

- 6 service pages

- 3 local area pages

- Privacy policy and terms and conditions pages



Your Responsibilities

1. Build and publish websites. You will receive step-by-step guidance during your 2 week training period. Expectations are lower during your first month working independently (trial period). By the end of the month-long trial period we expect you to be ramped up to full output.

2. Follow our site-completion checklist in Notion so every site is built the same way, with consistent quality and structure.

3. Use AI tools to generate page content and images, then edit them for quality, accuracy, and natural readability.

4. Apply on-page SEO to every page: title tags, meta descriptions, headings, keywords, image alt text, and internal links.

5. Check every site before it goes live (mobile view, formatting, broken links, duplicate content) using the checklist.

6. Send a quick daily update to the team with a screenshot of your Notion progress bar as you check off tasks.



Required Skills and Experience

- Working knowledge of SEO basics (on-page SEO, keywords, search intent). Beginners with solid fundamentals are welcome. Applicants with advanced SEO experience preferred.

- Working comfortably with AI tools like ChatGPT or Claude for writing, and AI image generators. You don't need to be an expert, but you should already be using them.

- Proficient written and verbal English. We meet weekly over video, so comfort in communicating in English is preferred.

- Comfortable learning new software quickly, especially website builders and Notion



Nice to Have (we'll teach you if you don't have these)

- Experience with any website builder (WordPress, Wix, Squarespace, GoHighLevel, etc.)

- Local SEO experience



Soft Skills

- Curious and eager to grow. We want someone who plans to keep learning and building their skillset.

- A team player who communicates openly, asks for help when needed, and supports teammates

- Fast learner who enjoys picking up new tools

- Self-starter who works well without constant supervision

- Strong attention to detail

- Able to reliably complete tasks to company standard while thinking outside the box to improve existing processes



Schedule and Meetings

- Full-time, 40 hours/week

- Fully flexible hours. We care about output, not when you're online.

- We meet every Monday morning as a team over video to review progress and plan the week, with extra check-ins during the week as needed.

- Please be available 7-8 AM Philippine time for meetings.

- Extra hours may be available.



Pay and Benefits

- Base pay of
USD/month ($4.06-$5.00/hour), depending on experience and test results. Training and trial are both paid at your full base pay.

- Performance bonuses, including a bonus for consistently hitting your weekly output

- Quarterly reviews with potential raises, including when the company reaches key milestones

- 13th month pay, available after your trial period and prorated based on your time with the company

- 10 paid holidays

- Paid time off (PTO) that accrues based on years of service



Training and Growth

- Paid 2-week training on our site-building workflow, tools, and SEO process

- 1-month paid trial period after training

- As we grow, you'll have opportunities to learn new skills and take on different responsibilities within the team.



How to Apply

1.
 us with "I Build Sites That Rank" as the subject line. Applications without it won't be reviewed.

2. We'll reply with a 1-minute video introducing our recruitment team.

3. Reply with your own video (under 1 minute) introducing yourself and why you're interested.

4. Shortlisted applicants will complete a $40 paid test task. We provide the platform and instructions, and you'll follow our prompts to create the output using AI tools and show us your SEO skills.

5. Top candidates will start our 2-week paid training, followed by a 1-month paid trial.



Questions before applying? Ask away!

Rebooking current clients and ensuring they repeat treatments. 



You must have:



Proven experience as an Appointment Setter, Sales VA, or Cold Caller (min. 1 year).

Strong spoken English and a confident, warm, professional phone presence — comfortable handling objections without being pushy.

title: Part-Time Bookkeeper & Financial Operations Specialist
description:
Eden Digital is a U.S.-based digital marketing agency providing SEO, paid advertising, website development, and digital marketing services to businesses across multiple industries.



We are looking for an experienced, dependable Bookkeeper & Financial Operations Specialist to help manage our day-to-day financial operations, maintain accurate records, develop and manage budgets, and keep our business finances organized.



This position is ideal for someone who enjoys working independently, takes ownership of responsibilities, and can proactively identify financial issues before they become problems.



We are not looking for someone who simply enters transactions into accounting software. We want someone who can help us stay financially organized, make informed budgeting decisions, and maintain healthy cash flow.



## Key Responsibilities



### 1. Client Invoicing & Accounts Receivable



- Create, schedule, and send recurring client invoices through QuickBooks Online.

- Ensure all clients are invoiced accurately and on time.

- Monitor incoming payments and reconcile payments against outstanding invoices.

- Follow up professionally with clients regarding overdue payments.

- Maintain accurate client billing records.

- Track outstanding invoices and anticipated incoming revenue.

- Identify and report billing discrepancies.



### 2. Accounts Payable & Bill Management



- Maintain an organized schedule of recurring business expenses, subscriptions, vendor invoices, and payment deadlines.

- Review upcoming bills and prepare payments for approval.

- Assist with scheduling approved payments and bank transfers.

- Monitor business credit card charges and recurring subscriptions.

- Periodically audit expenses to identify unnecessary, duplicate, or unused services.

- Flag unusual charges, billing errors, or opportunities to reduce expenses.

- Ensure financial obligations are tracked and addressed before their due dates.



### 3. Payroll & Contractor Payments



- Assist with preparing and processing payroll through our designated payroll platform.

- Track contractor invoices and scheduled payments.

- Verify payment amounts and due dates.

- Maintain organized payment records.

- Ensure payroll and contractor payments are prepared accurately and on schedule.

- Coordinate with our accountant when necessary.



### 4. Budgeting & Financial Planning



- Develop and maintain a realistic monthly operating budget.

- Track spending against the budget and identify overages.

- Help establish spending limits for recurring business expenses.

- Recommend adjustments to the budget based on revenue and financial obligations.

- Help determine appropriate allocations for operating expenses, payroll, taxes, savings, and debt repayment.

- Identify opportunities to reduce expenses and improve financial efficiency.

- Conduct monthly budget reviews and recommend adjustments.

- Help maintain financial accountability and prevent unnecessary spending.



### 5. Cash Flow & Debt Management



- Monitor cash balances and upcoming financial obligations.

- Maintain a rolling cash-flow forecast showing expected revenue and expenses.

- Help determine how much cash should remain available for operating expenses and financial reserves.

- Maintain a debt tracking system with outstanding balances, interest rates, minimum payments, and due dates.

- Develop and update a practical debt repayment plan.

- Recommend how much money can reasonably be allocated toward debt repayment each month.

- Help prioritize payments while protecting essential operating cash.

- Identify potential cash-flow shortages in advance.

- Prepare recommendations for transferring funds between business accounts when necessary.



### 6. Bookkeeping & Financial Reporting



- Maintain accurate financial records in QuickBooks Online.

- Categorize and reconcile bank and credit card transactions.

- Review account balances and investigate discrepancies.

- Maintain organized documentation of financial transactions.

- Prepare monthly profit and loss reports.

- Provide simple, easy-to-understand financial summaries.

- Coordinate with our U.S.-based CPA or accountant as needed.



## Weekly & Monthly Deliverables



**Weekly Financial Summary**



Provide a concise report showing:



- Current available cash balances.

- Outstanding client invoices and expected payments.

- Bills and payroll coming due.

- Estimated cash remaining after upcoming obligations.

- Recommended transfers or payments requiring approval.

- Any unusual expenses or financial concerns.



**Monthly Financial Review**



- Updated business budget.

- Budget versus actual spending.

- Monthly revenue and expense summary.

- Updated cash-flow forecast.

- Debt balances and recommended repayment allocations.

- Expense reduction opportunities.

- Reconciled financial records.



Reports should be straightforward, actionable, and easy to understand. We prefer clear recommendations over lengthy financial reports.



## Required Qualifications



- Minimum 2 years of professional bookkeeping experience.

- Experience working with U.S.-based businesses.

- Strong proficiency in QuickBooks Online.

- Demonstrated experience with accounts payable and accounts receivable.

- Experience preparing budgets and managing cash-flow forecasts.

- Familiarity with payroll and contractor payment processes.

- Strong Excel or Google Sheets skills.

- Excellent attention to detail and accuracy.

- Strong written and verbal English communication.

- Ability to work independently and meet deadlines consistently.

- Strong organizational skills and a proactive approach to financial management.

- Ability to handle confidential financial information professionally.

- Willingness to provide at least two verifiable professional references.



## Preferred Qualifications



- Experience working with digital marketing agencies or other service-based businesses.

- Experience managing recurring monthly client billing.

- Experience helping small-business owners develop budgets and debt repayment plans.

- Familiarity with U.S. business accounting practices.

- Experience identifying unnecessary business expenses and improving cash flow.



## What We're Looking For



Our ideal candidate is someone who:



- Takes ownership of responsibilities without needing constant reminders.

- Proactively identifies upcoming financial obligations.

- Notices discrepancies and investigates them.

- Understands the importance of protecting cash flow.

- Can make practical budgeting recommendations.

- Is comfortable managing multiple recurring financial tasks.

- Communicates clearly and provides regular updates.

- Values accuracy, confidentiality, and accountability.

- Is interested in building a long-term working relationship.



We want someone who helps us stay ahead of our finances rather than simply reporting what has already happened.



## Financial Access & Security



This position may involve access to confidential business financial information, accounting records, and payment preparation systems.



All significant financial transactions, bank transfers, and payments will require owner approval. The selected candidate will work within established access permissions and financial controls.



## How to Apply



Please include the following in your application:



1. A brief introduction and overview of your bookkeeping experience.

2. Your experience working with U.S.-based businesses.

3. Your experience using QuickBooks Online.

4. Details about your experience creating budgets and managing cash flow.

5. An example of how you helped a previous client improve financial organization, reduce expenses, or manage payments. 

6. Your hourly rate and weekly availability.

7. Confirmation that you can provide two professional references from previous clients or employers.

- Maintain clear notes on actions taken, current status, deadlines, and next steps so others can follow the work without unnecessary back-and-forth.

Qualifications

title: Editorial / Educational DOCX Template Designer
description:
I am looking for an experienced editorial / educational document designer to create the universal lesson-packet design system for AnyText, an AI-assisted platform for adult ESL teachers.



PROJECT:

$300 fixed-price project. Some flexibility for an exceptional candidate with highly relevant experience.



AnyText takes an authentic article or transcript, adapts it to an adult ESL proficiency level, generates coordinated instructional activities, and exports the finished lesson as an editable Microsoft Word DOCX.



This is NOT simply a beautification project.



I need a professional, reusable document-design system that can eventually be implemented programmatically by my developer.



The template must work with VARIABLE CONTENT.



For example:

- A reading may be 1, 2, or 3+ pages

- Titles and questions may vary in length

- Activities may be included or omitted

- Sections may contain different numbers of items

- Images may be present or absent

- Teachers may edit the DOCX after export



The design therefore must reflow gracefully. I am not looking for one beautiful static mockup that only works with one sample lesson.



My developer will handle the DOCX programming. You will design the visual system and provide clear specifications he can implement.



DESIGN DIRECTION:



Adult-accessible editorial design.



Professional, scholarly, warm, calm, readable, restrained, and appropriate for adult learners.



Visual inspiration includes:

- The forest-moon atmosphere of Endor from Star Wars

- University libraries and reading rooms

- Independent bookstores

- Forest-facing study spaces

- The warmth and craftsmanship of older Starbucks interiors

- Oxford University Press

- Cambridge University Press

- The New York Times

- The Economist

- National Geographic



These are inspiration references only. I do not want literal Star Wars imagery, trees, fake wood, coffee-shop graphics, or a fake newspaper design.



The established AnyText palette is:



Deep Forest Green — #183F36

Dark Green-Black — #1F2B27

Charcoal — #303633

Mushroom Taupe — #A79D90

Warm Stone — #D8D1C6

Parchment — #F2EDE3

Paper White — #FCFBF8

Bronze / Umber — #8B6B50



I am NOT looking for a new color palette.



The final document must also remain professional when printed or photocopied in black and white.



SECTIONS TO DESIGN INCLUDE:



- Article title and metadata

- Images

- Contextual Introduction

- Key Concepts

- Warm-Up

- Main Reading

- Vocabulary Matching

- Vocabulary Fill-in-the-Blank

- Multiple Choice

- True / False

- Short Answer

- Discussion

- Pair Work

- Mingle

- Answer Key

- Headers / footers

- Page numbering



Each activity should belong to one unified visual system while still supporting its instructional purpose.



For example:

- Reading should feel like a professionally published educational reader

- Short Answer needs appropriate writing space

- Discussion should feel spacious and reflective

- Pair Work should make roles immediately understandable

- Mingle should support printable cut-apart strips/cards

- Answer Key should be compact and easy for teachers to scan



The final specification should define:



- Exact fonts

- Font sizes and weights

- Heading hierarchy

- Reading-body typography

- Directions and question styles

- Metadata treatment

- Line and paragraph spacing

- Margins

- Tables

- Borders

- Answer spaces

- Image placement and sizing

- Headers / footers

- Page numbering

- Page-break behavior

- Color usage

- Black-and-white behavior

- Rules for variable-length content



EDITABLE DOCX IS IMPORTANT:



Teachers will be able to rewrite questions, add notes, delete material, and otherwise edit the exported Word document.



The design therefore needs a strong underlying style system rather than fragile manual formatting.



ORIGINAL HUMAN DESIGN WORK REQUIRED:



I already use AI extensively to create educational resources and to develop AnyText. I am not hiring someone because I need another person to generate educational materials with AI.



I am hiring for professional HUMAN editorial and educational design judgment.



Please do not submit AI-generated workbook mockups or AI-generated template images that cannot function as a real editable document system.



I have worked with textbooks and instructional materials for many years and am specifically looking for someone with real experience in typography, page composition, long-form layout, educational publishing, or book/workbook design.



IDEAL EXPERIENCE:



- Editorial design

- Book / textbook / workbook layout

- Educational publishing

- Adobe InDesign

- Typesetting

- Master pages

- Paragraph / character / object styles

- Print production

- Microsoft Word / DOCX templates

- Dynamic or variable-content documents



I will provide:

- The existing AnyText logo

- The established visual direction

- The established color palette

- Several real AnyText-generated lesson packets



HOW TO APPLY:



Please send:

1. A short introduction

2. 3–5 highly relevant portfolio samples

3. Any book, textbook, workbook, educational, editorial, report, or long-form layout examples

4. Any experience with Microsoft Word / DOCX templates

5. Any experience designing for variable or dynamically generated content

6. Your project estimate and turnaround time

7. One relevant portfolio piece and three design decisions you personally made on that project and why



Please begin your application with:



FOREST READER



FINAL STANDARD:



Whether an AnyText packet is 4 pages or 14 pages, a teacher should be able to download it, make small edits, print it, staple it, and hand it to an adult ESL class—and it should still look like it came from a professional educational publisher.

title: Video Editor - Ecommerce
description:
Video Editor — DTC Performance Ads | VetPets



Hey future team member — glad you're here.



We're a fast-scaling DTC pet health brand running performance ads across the US, UK, and AU. We're hiring an experienced video editor who wants to focus on one brand, work alongside other video editors, learn quickly, and create bangers.



You'll get to know our products, customers, and creative strategy — then use that knowledge to make better ads every week.



Who we're looking for:



- 2+ years editing direct response / performance ads, ideally for DTC e-commerce brands.

- Strong instincts for hooks, pacing, storytelling, and visuals that keep people watching.

- Fluent written and spoken English — you'll be on calls and reading briefs daily.

- Heavy AI tool user — voiceovers, image generation, video generation, upscaling, and more. We want someone who actively uses AI to improve speed and quality.

- Independent operator — you read a brief, ask smart questions, and execute.

- Fast without sacrificing quality, open to feedback, and hungry to improve.

- Available full-time during Philippine daytime hours — this is NOT a night-shift role.



What you'll do:



- Edit performance video ads for Meta, primarily VSL-style ads around 60–120 seconds.

- Create strong hooks and variations so we can test more creative.

- Work with provided UGC and B-roll, source footage when needed, and generate supporting assets with AI.

- Collaborate with our other editors, share ideas, and learn from what performs.

- Turn feedback into stronger edits and ship consistently.



What we offer:



- A long-term role focused on one brand.

- A team of other video editors to collaborate and grow with.

- Clear briefs, direct feedback, and room to bring your own ideas.

- The opportunity to learn quickly through real creative testing.

- Pay that grows with the quality and value of your work.



How to apply:



Start your message with "A-player". Applications without this will be ignored.



Want to really stand out? Show us your best work and introduce yourself.



Include:



1. A direct link to the ONE ad you're most proud of editing. Tell us briefly what you did and why you chose it. If you have performance results, include them. Please don't send a huge folder or dozens of ads — we want to see your strongest example.

2. A one-minute Loom video introducing yourself. Tell us about your experience and why you'd like to join VetPets. Keep it simple — no fancy editing needed.

3. Which AI tools you use regularly and how you use them in your editing workflow



You can also include your portfolio, but put your best ad and Loom links first. Make sure all links work without requesting access.



Looking forward to meeting you!



Jacob Johansson  

VetPets

title: AI Animation Ad Creator (Pixar-Style 3D + Suno Music) for a US Bag Brand
description:
AI Animation Video Ads (Pixar-Style 3D + Suno Music) for a Women’s Bag Brand, US Market



About Lunelle



Lunelle designs bags that are both stylish and practical, made for women’s real everyday lives. Most crossbody bags look nice but have no room, no organization and not much common sense. We fix that.

Our hero product is La Spacieuse, an oversized crescent-shaped crossbody bag worn across the body on a wide, adjustable strap. It looks elegant, but it holds far more than you’d expect:



A large main compartment (about a gallon of capacity)

Water- and stain-resistant material

A comfortable, adjustable strap

A secure back pocket for valuables, plus a second front pocket



Our main customers are moms of kids aged 6 months to 6 years. They want one bag that holds their own things and the kids’ essentials (wipes, snacks, pacifiers, a favorite stuffed animal) while keeping their hands free. 



What we’re looking for

A creator who specializes in AI animation ads and AI music ads made with Suno.

The references here show you what we’re after: 





3D animation in the Pixar style: expressive characters, cinematic lighting, fast cuts, bold on-screen captions, all in vertical 9:16.

Storytelling first, product second: either a short, funny skit where objects come to life and talk (for example, the “old solutions” admitting why they fail), or a longer emotional story told in the first person that builds to a satisfying payoff.

An original soundtrack or sung narration made with Suno, together with voiceover where it helps, so the ad feels like entertainment rather than an ad.

A clear direct-response ending: the product, the benefit and a call to action.

We supply the script direction. You generate the scenes, animation, character consistency, sound and editing.



How to apply

Start your reply with the word “LUNELLE” so we know you read the brief. Applications that don’t start with it won’t be reviewed.



Then include:

Links to 2 or 3 AI animation ads you’ve made (ads that used Suno music are a big plus)

The tools you use (video, image, voice and music)

Your rate for a 30 to 60 second animated ad.

Your usual turnaround time

We look forward to seeing your work.

title: Industrial Designer / Product Design Engineer – Modular Body Scrubber
description:
** Must apply at: 
 **



We are developing Pebble Scrub, a premium handheld body scrub system inspired by the smooth, organic shape of a river stone.



The product will feature a durable, reusable Pebble body with interchangeable scrubbing attachments, allowing customers to choose different textures and replace attachments while keeping the main body.



We are looking for an experienced Industrial Designer / Product Design Engineer to develop the product through material selection, ergonomic design, mechanical engineering, functional prototyping, and manufacturing preparation.



The goal is a product that feels comfortable, performs well in actual shower use, and can be manufactured at a commercially viable cost.



The product should include:



Reusable Pebble body: A compact, lightweight frame with a premium appearance, comfortable handling, and secure grip with wet, soapy hands. Final material, dimensions, and construction are open to your recommendations.



Interchangeable scrubbing attachments: Potential options include soft silicone, African-net-style exfoliating mesh, and a lathering sponge. Charcoal-containing sponge or textile options may also be explored.



Shared attachment system: A secure, discreet connection that supports different attachment materials and allows easy removal for replacement, rinsing, and drying.



Practical drying/storage solution: A hanging loop or another well-integrated solution.



We have explored an earlier concept and identified several areas requiring improvement: excessive size and weight, overly stiff silicone, and inadequate lathering. These findings will help guide development.



Your responsibilities will include:



Recommend suitable materials and manufacturing processes for the body, attachments, and any attachment carriers or backing components.



Develop the Pebble shape for comfortable use across different adult hand sizes.



Establish target dimensions and weight early, supported by printable sizing models and estimated production weight.



Evaluate attachment mechanisms such as mechanical retention, magnetic attachment, or another practical approach.



Ensure attachments remain secure during wet scrubbing, twisting, and repeated removal. If magnets are proposed, address corrosion protection and secure retention within the product.



Engineer a common connection that works with both molded silicone and textile/sponge attachments.



Develop and compare suitable silicone softness, thickness, and surface patterns through physical samples.



Address lathering, rinsing, drainage, drying, and access for cleaning.



Apply design-for-manufacturing principles, including wall thickness, draft, parting lines, tolerances, assembly, and tooling complexity.



Support prototype evaluation and revisions based on actual use.



Development should follow clear milestones, beginning with the body’s size, handling, material direction, and connection concept.



Early STL files are required so we can print sizing models in-house before detailed engineering proceeds. Functional prototypes should then be used to evaluate weight, wet grip, attachment security, scrubbing feel, and lathering before final manufacturing decisions.



Required deliverables include:



Editable native CAD files for all designed parts and assemblies.



STEP/STP files for manufacturing and supplier review.



STL files for early sizing checks and subsequent prototypes.



Dimensioned drawings with critical interface dimensions and tolerances.



Exploded assembly views and a bill of materials.



Material, surface finish, and manufacturing recommendations.



A prototype/testing plan and documented revisions.



Updated design files following agreed manufacturer DFM feedback.



For textile or sponge attachments, provide appropriate material and assembly specifications alongside CAD for their carriers.



We will provide concept images, reference products, written requirements, feedback from earlier prototype testing, and clear feedback throughout development.



Please include the following in your application:



Two or three relevant physical products you personally designed or engineered. Explain your role and whether they reached manufacturing.



Your CAD software and the editable file formats you can provide.



Your experience with injection-molded plastics, silicone components, and interchangeable attachment systems.



Any experience with personal-care products, wet-use products, or textile/sponge integration.



How you would validate size, weight, and attachment performance early.



Your proposed milestones, availability, and timeline for the first printable sizing models.



Your estimated fees, included revision rounds, and any prototype or supplier coordination services you offer.



This is a project-based opportunity with a flexible budget for the right expertise. Please identify design fees and external prototype/manufacturing expenses separately.



Clear communication, weekly progress updates, and delivery of current CAD files at agreed milestones are essential.

title: Operations Assistant
description:
Facelove is a direct-to-consumer cosmetics brand for women over 45, selling in Germany and the US. We run our own paid media and creative production, a physical supply chain with a manufacturer and a fulfilment partner, customer support in two languages, and sixteen departments and partners that all report numbers every week.



The COO runs day-to-day operations across all of it. This role is her second pair of hands and eyes: the person who makes sure every commitment made in a meeting turns into a task, every task has an owner and a date, and every owner is chased before the deadline rather than after it. You will spend a lot of time in ClickUp, Notion, Slack and spreadsheets, and a lot of time asking people where things stand.



This is a role for someone who has done this before and likes it. We are not looking for a generalist VA who needs a task list each morning. We are looking for an operator who reads the week, sees what is going to slip, and fixes it before it does.



The job splits into three areas. Most of the week is accountability and follow-up; the rest is the operating cadence, documentation and whatever the COO hands over. The common thread is holding other people to what they said they would deliver.



1. Accountability and follow-up

-Meetings become tasks the same day. Owner, due date, definition of done, in ClickUp. Nothing stays only in someone's memory.

-Chase owners before deadlines, not after. Post a daily overdue list and get a written status or a new date from each person.

-Keep the OKR tracker current. No blank cells, every red item flagged with its owner and a recovery plan.

-Hold the creative pods to their output targets. Track each editor against their points through the week, flag anyone falling short before the week closes, and chase the gap rather than reporting it afterwards.



2. Operating cadence and documentation

-Keep the SOP library organized and current, so people can find the right version and nothing in it is out of date.

-Schedule, reschedule and prep one-on-ones, partner calls and reviews. Every call has an agenda and a notes page before it starts.



3. General operations support

-Inbox and calendar triage for the COO, with clear flags for anything costing money, anything a customer sees, or anyone blocked.

-Onboarding and offboarding admin with HR: access sheets, tool invites, first-week plans, equipment and credential handover.

-Research and comparison work: tool trials, vendor quotes, benchmarks, summarized in one page with a recommendation.

-Anything else that keeps operations running. You will be asked to do unglamorous work, and the role only works if you are good at it.



NON-NEGOTIABLE SKILLS

-3+ years in operations supporting a founder, COO or ops lead at an ecommerce or DTC brand, agency or startup. Not a first job, not a generalist VA role made of inbox and data entry.

-Can name a time they chased someone senior to them and got the thing delivered. Comfortable sending the third reminder.

-Builds lists, statuses, custom fields, automations and dashboards, not just ticks tasks.

-Lookups, pivots, conditional formatting, a tracker built from scratch that other people can use.

-Writes and organizes documentation others can find and follow.

-Clear, short, no errors. Most of the job is writing to people who are busy.

-Has written SOPs that someone else actually followed. Can show one.

-Catches the wrong date, the missing owner, the invoice line that doesn't match. Does not let small things through because there are many of them.

-09:00 to 18:00 CET, Monday to Friday, with a reliable connection and a quiet workspace.



NICE TO HAVE

-Experience with OKRs or EOS-style scorecards and weekly meetings.

-Has worked alongside a creative or performance marketing team and understands how output targets are set and measured.

-Fathom, Hubstaff or Slack admin.



HOW TO APPLY AND HIRING PROCESS

Send a message. Put the words "Ops Assistant, Facelove" in the subject line or first field so we know you read the posting.

About Us



SoHa Living and SoHa Keiki are Hawaiʻi-based retail and lifestyle brands specializing in beautiful home décor, gifts, accessories, and children's products inspired by island living.



We are growing our creative team and looking for a talented, highly creative AI Video Content Creator to join us full-time.



Our existing AI creative team uses Kive.ai to develop product photography and lifestyle imagery for both brands. We are now looking for someone dedicated exclusively to transforming these images into stunning, realistic, and engaging video content.



About the Role



You will be responsible for creating high-quality AI-generated videos for our social media platforms, websites, digital advertisements, and marketing campaigns.



You will collaborate closely with our AI image creation team, using existing product and lifestyle imagery to bring our products and brand stories to life through movement, animation, and engaging visual storytelling.



We are looking for someone with a strong creative eye who understands how to make AI-generated videos look natural, realistic, professional, and visually beautiful.

- Maintain consistency in model appearance, product details, lighting, styling, and overall brand aesthetic.

- Ensure that AI-generated movement, facial expressions, and interactions look realistic and natural without altering the appearance of our established models.



Key Responsibilities



AI Video Creation

AI Innovation & Improvement

Required:

Preferred:

- Experience with other AI video platforms such as Kling, Runway, or similar tools.

- Experience creating content for retail, e-commerce, home décor, fashion, or lifestyle brands.

- Experience optimizing videos for Shopify websites.

- Understanding of Instagram Reels, TikTok, and short-form video trends.

What We're Looking For



Our ideal candidate is someone who:



- Has a passion for AI technology and digital creativity.

- Has a refined aesthetic and strong attention to detail.

title: DTC E-commerce Video Editor + AI Animations for Meta Ads - $1,500/mo + Up to $500 Per Winning Ad
description:
$1,500/month base + up to $500 bonus on every winning ad. Full-time. Remote. One seat.



We're Obvira (
), a fast-growing DTC e-commerce brand in baby wellness. Our growth runs on direct-response video ads on
 and Instagram. We test new creative every week, and your edits go live on real ad spend. You work directly with the founder. No agency, no approval chain, same-day answers.



This is a DTC e-commerce ad editing seat. If you haven't edited ads that sell physical products on Meta, this isn't the role for you.



Examples of what we run: 



WHY THIS SEAT IS OPEN

We've had editors who did good work when told exactly what to do. That's not enough anymore. We need someone who takes a brief and the vision, makes the right calls on their own, and gets it close on the first pass. We'd rather pay more for that person than keep catching basics in review.



THE ROLE

- Take briefs (script + reference) and ship them as finished Meta ads. UGC-style, animated, illustrated. 15 to 60 seconds.

- 5 to 7 batches a week. One batch = 1 finished body + 3 to 5 hook variations.

- 24 to 48 hour turnaround per batch.

- Our stack: Premiere or CapCut, After Effects or equivalent for animation, Higgsfield and ElevenLabs for AI footage, avatars and voice.

- You see the numbers on your own ads every week. Winners get variations. Losers teach us.



WHO WE'RE LOOKING FOR

- Proven DTC e-commerce ad editor. You've cut ads for physical product brands on Meta or TikTok and you know what a product ad needs: hook, problem, proof, offer, CTA.

- You animate and illustrate, not just cut. Motion graphics, illustrated scenes, animated characters, built from scratch when the brief calls for it. This is part of the job, not a bonus skill, and your portfolio proves it.

- Close on the first pass. Basics are handled before it reaches us: right aspect ratio, captions proofed, audio synced, every hook exported and named. One round of notes, then it's done.

- Notes stick. We don't give the same feedback twice.

- Vision in, ad out. You ask the smart questions up front, then execute without a step-by-step.

- Marketer first, editor second. You care whether the ad converts, not just whether it looks clean.

- Hungry. You want to be the lead editor as we scale, and you'll earn it on results.



We'll teach you the marketing psychology behind our ads and pay for that training. We won't teach you how to edit or animate. You bring that.



DON'T APPLY IF

- Your portfolio is YouTube, wedding, corporate or agency reels with no DTC product ads

- You need every edit explained step by step

- You ship and let the client find the mistakes

- You only cut footage and can't animate or illustrate

- You edit for pretty, not for conversions

- You can't give this 40 hours a week



COMP

- $1,500/month base

- Up to $500 bonus on every winning ad, no cap on how many you can earn

- Winners are d
 by how much of our ad spend the ad takes and the return it drives. You see the numbers that d
 it, every week.

- Reviewed at 30 days on output. Consistently ship winners and the base goes up.

- Paid marketing and creative strategy training

- Flexible hours, hard deadlines



HOW TO APPLY

Start your message with the word "FRAME" or it won't be read. Then:

1. Your portfolio link.

2. One UGC-style DTC product ad you cut yourself that ran on Meta or TikTok. Link it and tell us what you did on it.

3. One AI animation ad you made that performed. Link it, name the tools, and tell us how it did.

4. How many hours a week you're currently committed to other clients.

5. What are you looking to get out of this role?

6. Anything else we should know?



Shortlisted applicants get a paid test batch, then a 20-minute call. Offer within a week.



No resume. Show us the work.
