title: AI Operations Lead
description:
We are a group of four companies hiring one exceptional person to run operations across the board using AI tools. You will build and operate the systems that enable each company to run efficiently. You will not replace functional managers or assume responsibility for people management.

ARC Group: In-office BPO teams (10+) for mid-sized US companies. No onboarding fees, no contract lock-in.

ARC Remote: Managed remote staffing for US small businesses.

Kipkeh Media: A WhatsApp media channel for the Orthodox Jewish community.

SetCo / 
: Business entity-formation services.

You will report directly to the Founder and work closely with our Chief of Staff. She builds the structures, systems, and trusted ground operations; you bring AI-powered execution, optimization, and intelligence. You offer complementary strengths, not a hierarchy.



CORE OPERATING PRINCIPLES



Read this carefully: This is a job for a professional who is exceptionally good at using AI tools, not someone who "uses ChatGPT sometimes." You will take entire workflows, lead generation, performance reporting, content planning, billing, and follow-ups, and rebuild them so one person with the right AI stack can do what used to take a team.

However, AI is a means, not the objective:

Impact over tools: We do not automate for automation’s sake. Every system you build must improve revenue, speed, accuracy, cost, visibility, or operational capacity.

Build before you automate: You don’t automate broken processes. First, understand the business objective, map the workflow, identify failure points, simplify the process, and then automate.

Human judgment: You know when NOT to automate. You understand where client relationships, management decisions, and executive judgment must remain human.



AUTHORITY & ESCALATION



You are expected to independently identify problems, recommend solutions, and implement approved operational improvements. You may modify systems and workflows within your area of ownership, but significant changes affecting clients, staffing, pricing, contracts, or company-wide processes require Founder approval.



PRIORITIES (In Order)



ARC Group Pipeline: This is the money. Build the machine that fills it.

ARC Remote: Systematize operations until the Founder only shows up for relationships and closing.

Kipkeh Operations: Manage the money workflow, creator direction, and performance intelligence.

NewLLC Automations: Set up processes alongside the Chief of Staff so we can hire an admin to handle client relations, billing, and upselling.



THE MANDATE



Process & SOP Automation: Automate and continuously improve operational workflows. Coordinate with the Chief of Staff and functional owners before materially changing established processes.

Data & AI Responsibility: You will handle sensitive business, client, and employee data. You must follow data-handling rules and never upload confidential information into an unauthorized AI platform.

Marketing: Our highest-leverage early win (see below).

Sales Support: Pipeline tracking, follow-up systems, and proposal/invoice workflows. (Closing stays with the Founder).

Recruitment: Help hire the roles behind you via screening support, structured interview workflows, and candidate tracking.

Management Oversight (Systems, not people): Build the intelligence layer our managers run on (dashboards, KPI tracking, staffing-ratio models). You make problems visible early with data. When systems flag a problem, you bring the data to the manager/Founder; they handle the human side.

Systems Design: Build workflows that don't break, with edge cases handled and clean, documented handoffs.

Data & Reporting: Turn raw, messy operational data into decisions (daily numbers, weekly analysis, forecasts).

Content Operations: Direct our on-camera creator with data-backed briefs outlining what to film, when, and why.

Billing & Invoicing: Build the money workflow from zero and run it.

Keep Up & Be Ahead: Your AI stack is never stale. You bring us tools and methods before we know we need them.



YOUR FIRST BIG WIN: BUILD OUR MARKETING ENGINE



Our Chief of Staff currently runs a manual
 lead-gen motion for ARC Group (50–100
s, no sequences, no A/B testing). It is time-consuming and inefficient. The stack is already paid for: Google Workspace + Instantly + Apollo + NeverBounce.

Your job: Turn it into a real pipeline machine.

Target: 500+
s/week with proper sequences, A/B testing, AI-assisted personalization, tracked follow-ups, and a dashboard the Founder can read in 60 seconds.

Bonus: You will also run the support system behind the Founder's LinkedIn outreach.

The Audience: 50–250 employee companies in logistics/supply chain, medical offices, and voice agents (call centers).

The Offer: In-office BPO teams, no onboarding fees, no contract lock-in.

This is how we land our next BPO clients, and it is the single highest-leverage thing you can do in your first 60 days.



WHAT YOU'LL OWN



The Pipeline Machine: ICP list building, Instantly sequences, A/B tests, reply triage, follow-up automation, and weekly dashboards. The engine runs; you report the numbers.

ARC Remote Systematization: Map every workflow the Founder touches and pull them off his plate one by one until it runs day-to-day without him.

The Money Workflow: Advertiser roster, rate sheets, invoices generated from published logs, overdue tracking, and a Monday money dashboard.

Creator Direction: Turn weekly view data into specific daily shoot briefs backed by numbers, not vibes.

Performance Intelligence: Daily view-curve reports. Flag underperforming posts within hours. Deliver a one-page weekly "what's working" analysis to drive next week's plan.

Management Intelligence: Dashboards, alerts, and KPI tracking. You build the visibility; managers handle the people.

Founder's Daily Digest: One morning briefing covering yesterday's numbers, today's plan, and decisions needed.



MUST-HAVES

Demonstrable AI Expertise: LLMs (advanced prompting, custom agents), spreadsheet automation (complex formulas, Apps Script), data analysis, and workflow automation (Zapier, Make, n8n, etc.). We test this live—claims without proof will not pass.

Data Skills: Proven ability to build reports and dashboards from raw, messy data.

Lead-Gen Experience:
 outreach, list building, sequencing, and follow-up tracking (or a credible plan to build this fast).

Finance Systems: Experience building/running a billing/invoicing tracker (or the ability to design one from scratch in the interview).

Communication: Strong written English. Clear, brief, and structured asynchronous communication.

Availability: Full-time (40 hours/week), Philippines-based, on a steady, fixed schedule with US-morning (EST) overlap.

Exclusivity: No job stacking, no exceptions. This must be your only full-time job. No freelance clients or side gigs that compete for your hours or attention.

Professional Setup: 16GB+ RAM, backup internet, and backup power.



NICE-TO-HAVES

Media or content-operations experience.

Experience with remote teams across time zones.

Familiarity with Orthodox Jewish community norms (modesty and kashrus guardrails apply to our channel)—or a willingness to learn fast.



WHAT SUCCESS LOOKS LIKE



Day 14:
 engine is live (500+/week sending on Instantly with sequences and A/B tests). Baseline bounce/unsubscribe rates tracked. First sprint launched; LinkedIn support running. ARC Remote audit complete, with the first workflow pulled off the Founder's plate. Money workflow started. (Trial decision point: You must be performing at band level, or we part ways).

Day 30:
 engine at full volume. Focus shifts to quality metrics: positive reply rate, meetings booked, and cost/time per qualified opportunity. Reply triage and follow-up system operating with same-day turnaround. ARC Remote SOPs delivered. Creator working from your briefs.

Day 60: The engine runs on rhythm without babysitting. ARC Remote workflows are documented, handed over, and tracking measurable hour/cost reductions. Underperformer alerts firing same-day. You are spotting what's broken across the companies before anyone else does.

Day 90: ARC Group top-of-funnel and ARC Remote run without Founder involvement. Kipkeh workflows are humming. We are actively scaling your systems across all four companies.



COMPENSATION & TERMS



Pay: $400-$500/week, paid weekly via Wise.

Growth: Full-time, long-term. Exceptional performers grow fast here, with a clear path for compensation increases across the four companies.

Trial Terms: The first 2 weeks are a paid trial. You enter at a band based on your interview, and you have two weeks to prove it was real. If you are not performing at your band's level, we part ways fast and fairly.



HOW TO APPLY



To be considered, you must provide direct, publicly viewable links (Google Drive, iCloud, etc.) to the following:

Updated Resume/CV: Highlighting your AI experience and the tools you are familiar with.

System Specs Screenshot: Including RAM (16GB minimum preferred; if your system can be upgraded, please state this).

Internet Speed Test Screenshot: Showing primary and backup speeds in Mbps.

Workspace & Power Photos: Showing a dedicated quiet workspace, plus your UPS, power station, or generator.

2-Minute Loom Video (Screen Share): Walk us through ONE real workflow you automated with AI tools. Show the "before," what you built, and the "after." This must be a real example, not a tutorial. No Loom = no review.

Fast-Track Hiring Process:

Candidates who submit a standout Loom video will be highly considered and fast-tracked to an Initial Interview before taking the paid test task.

Candidates who pass the Initial Interview will complete our paid test task ($25 USD via Wise).

Candidates who advance from the test task to the final Founder interview will receive an additional $25 USD.

title: Estimating Assistant
description:

Estimating Assistant



Job Type: Full-Time

Job Overview:

We are seeking a dependable and detail-oriented Estimating Assistant to support Advanced Framing Structures (AFS), a Southern California commercial rough-carpentry and wood-framing subcontractor. In this role, you will process bid invitations, download and organize project documents, maintain accurate bid records in HubSpot, and prepare plan files and overlays in PlanSwift. You will work closely with the estimating team to ensure bid opportunities, deadlines, and project documents are complete, organized, and ready for review. 



The ideal candidate has strong administrative processing skills, excellent attention to detail, and the ability to follow established procedures consistently. Construction experience is helpful but not required. This is an administrative support role, not an independent estimating, pricing, or decision-making position.



Key Responsibilities:

Bid Invitation Administration

* Monitor assigned estimating
 inboxes, bid portals, and other sources for new Invitations to Bid (ITBs).

* Download bid invitations and related project documents, including plans, specifications, addenda, bid instructions, and available project information.

* Enter or update bid opportunity information in HubSpot and other company tracking systems.

* Record bid due dates, project names, General Contractor information, locations, and other required opportunity details.

* Respond to bid invitations using approved company responses and direction from the estimating team.

* Record whether AFS intends to bid, decline, or requires estimator review before responding.

* Flag duplicate invitations, missing documents, unclear due dates, addenda, or other issues for estimator review.



Bid Document Organization

* Create and maintain organized electronic bid folders using AFS naming and filing standards.

* Save plans, specifications, addenda, bid forms, and other documents in the correct project folder.

* Maintain current versions of documents and clearly identify revised or superseded plan sets when directed.

* Notify the assigned estimator when new plans, addenda, or material bid documents are received.

* Help maintain an accurate and easy-to-follow electronic record for each bid opportunity.



PlanSwift Support

* Upload/import project plan sets into PlanSwift.

* Organize and label plan pages so estimators can locate drawings efficiently.

* Verify basic page orientation and plan-file completeness before handing the file to the estimator.

* Set up plan overlays to compare revised drawings against prior plan versions using the company's established process.

* Identify and flag apparent drawing changes shown by overlays for estimator review.

* Do not independently determine the estimating, scope, cost, or schedule impact of drawing changes.



HubSpot / CRM Administration

* Create and update bid opportunities, companies, contacts, due dates, stages, and activity information in HubSpot.

* Maintain clean and consistent CRM records and avoid duplicate companies, contacts, or opportunities.

* Update opportunity status based on direction from the estimating team.

* Assist with routine CRM data cleanup, record maintenance, and reporting support as assigned.

* HubSpot experience is preferred but not required, as training may be provided to candidates with strong administrative skills.



Estimating Team Support

* Maintain bid calendars, trackers, and administrative task lists as assigned.

* Assist estimators with locating, downloading, renaming, organizing, and distributing bid documents.

* Perform routine data entry and document-preparation tasks related to estimating.

* Follow up internally when information or direction is needed to complete an assigned administrative task.

* Support other routine estimating administrative work consistent with the level and purpose of the position.



Required Qualifications

* 1-3 years of experience in administrative support, data entry, document control, CRM administration, accounts payable, construction administration, estimating support, or a similar role is preferred.

* Strong attention to detail and the ability to maintain accuracy when handling repetitive tasks and high volumes of administrative information.

* Excellent digital file management and organizational skills.

* Proficiency in Microsoft Office or Microsoft 365 applications, particularly Outlook, Teams, and Excel.

* Experience downloading, uploading, renaming, organizing, and managing digital documents, especially large PDF files.

* Good written English and the ability to prepare concise, professional
s and communicate clearly with a U.S.-based team.

* Ability to follow written instructions, established procedures, checklists, and naming conventions consistently.

* Good judgment in identifying missing information, conflicting dates, duplicate records, revised documents, and other discrepancies.

* Ability to verify information, check work for errors, and use organized systems to maintain accuracy rather than relying solely on memory.

* Willingness to ask questions and escalate unclear instructions rather than guess or make unsupported assumptions.

* Ability to learn new software and workflows quickly and demonstrate tasks through screen sharing when required.

* Dependable, coachable, and comfortable performing repetitive, process-driven administrative work.

* Ability to work independently within clearly defined responsibilities and maintain reliable follow-through on assigned tasks.

* Reliable computer, internet connection, and a suitable professional remote-work environment.

* Ability to work the confirmed schedule aligned with AFS's Southern California operations.



Preferred Qualifications

* Experience with PlanSwift; familiarity with Bluebeam or similar PDF and plan-document software is an advantage.

* Experience with HubSpot or another CRM platform.

* Previous experience in construction administration, estimating support, bid coordination, or document control.

* Familiarity with construction plans, specifications, bid invitations, addenda, and general construction terminology.

* Experience using trackers, checklists, and standardized filing systems to maintain accurate records and prevent errors.

* Note: PlanSwift and HubSpot experience is preferred but not required.



Working Conditions

* This position focuses on administrative processing, document management, CRM maintenance, and plan preparation to support the estimating team.

* The employee will not make independent bid/no-bid decisions or determine which project scope should be included or excluded.

* Establishing labor, material, equipment, subcontractor, markup, or final bid pricing is outside the scope of this role.

* Independent final quantity takeoffs, estimating approvals, pricing negotiations, and contract decisions are not part of the position.

* The employee must not submit final proposals or make commitments on behalf of AFS without authorization.

* Plan overlays are prepared to help identify drawing revisions. Determining their scope, cost, or scheduling impact is the responsibility of the estimator.

* Missing documents, conflicting information, unclear instructions, and unusual requests must be escalated to the assigned estimator or estimating leader.

* The employee is expected to maintain organized records, follow established procedures, and communicate progress or issues promptly to the estimating team.



Note: An NBI or police clearance will be required upon acceptance of the job offer.

[Online Reputation Management and Community Forum Specialist (Part Time)]



TYPE OF WORK: Part Time

WAGE / SALARY: $8.00 to $9.00 per hour, depending on verified experience

HOURS PER WEEK: 20 to start

LOCATION: Remote (Philippines)



ABOUT US

We are a US based brand selling automotive covers and accessories. We sell through our own website and through Amazon and eBay.



POSITION OVERVIEW

We're looking for an experienced Online Reputation Management specialist to help strengthen our brand's presence across online communities and improve branded search results.



The primary focus of this role is monitoring and participating in relevant forums, identifying reputation risks, and helping legitimate positive or neutral content outrank negative search results over time.



This isn't primarily a customer-service or review-response position. Candidates should have direct experience with online communities, branded search results, content promotion, and ethical reputation-suppression strategies.



PRIMARY RESPONSIBILITIES

Community Forum Management

- Find relevant forums and online communities where customers discuss our brand, products, competitors, or industry.

- Monitor discussions for brand mentions, complaints, misinformation, product questions, and reputation risks.

- Participate through useful, natural, and non-promotional contributions.

- Draft thoughtful responses that don't sound defensive, scripted, or overly promotional.

- Identify forum discussions that rank for branded searches and recommend an appropriate response strategy.

- Track discussion URLs, dates, topics, responses, engagement, and search visibility.

- Escalate legal threats, safety complaints, refund disputes, coordinated attacks, or potentially defamatory content.



Branded Search and Reputation Suppression

- Monitor priority searches involving the brand name, reviews, complaints, scams, customer service, and relevant product terms.

- Identify negative URLs, their ranking positions, content types, authority, sentiment, and likelihood of being displaced.

- Help develop ethical suppression strategies using legitimate owned, earned, and third-party assets.

- Optimize company profiles, social profiles, business listings, articles, videos, interviews, and other brand-related assets.

- Coordinate the creation and promotion of useful branded content that can occupy additional first-page search positions.

- Monitor ranking changes and recommend adjustments based on actual performance.

- Distinguish between results that may be corrected, removed, responded to, deindexed, or outranked.



Content and Reputation Assets

- Develop content briefs for branded articles, FAQs, company profiles, interviews, case studies, customer stories, and expert content.

- Support legitimate third-party placements, contributor opportunities, interviews, partnerships, and company profiles.

- Improve the credibility of reputation assets through accurate company information, identifiable authorship, firsthand experience, original media, and expert commentary.

- Coordinate with SEO, content, customer service, and leadership when public responses or new assets require approval.



Monitoring and Reporting

- Track page-one and page-two results for priority branded searches.

- Monitor new forum discussions, articles, reviews, and brand mentions.

- Maintain a weekly tracker covering negative URL positions, positive and neutral assets on pages one and two, new brand mentions, discussions requiring action, assets created or optimized, ranking changes, open risks, and recommended next steps.



MUST-HAVE QUALIFICATIONS

- At least two years of hands-on experience in online reputation management, community management, branded SEO, or search-result suppression.

- Direct experience monitoring and participating in established online forums or communities.

- Experience evaluating branded search results and tracking the positions of negative, positive, and neutral URLs.

- Strong written English and the ability to adapt to the tone and rules of different communities.

- Basic working knowledge of SEO, search intent, content optimization, links, authority, and indexing.

- Ability to recognize when a public response could make a situation worse and should be escalated.

- Strong research, documentation, organization, and reporting skills.

- Ability to provide specific examples of past work and clearly explain your individual contribution.



NICE-TO-HAVE QUALIFICATIONS

- Experience managing ORM for an e-commerce or consumer brand.

- Experience improving branded search results through content, profiles, videos, digital PR, or legitimate third-party placements.

- Experience securing interviews, articles, contributor opportunities, citations, or editorial mentions.

- Familiarity with Google Business Profile, Trustpilot, BBB, social platforms, video platforms, and industry-specific forums.

- Experience using Ahrefs, Semrush, Google Search Console, rank-tracking platforms, or brand-monitoring tools.

- Knowledge of on-page SEO, internal linking, digital PR, entity optimization, and content distribution.

- Experience working with customer-service teams on complaint escalation and resolution.



PROHIBITED TACTICS

We're only interested in legitimate, sustainable reputation-management practices. The following tactics aren't permitted:

- Fake customer accounts or fabricated personal identities

- Fake reviews, testimonials, or customer experiences

- Review gating or incentives offered only for positive reviews

- Mass forum posting, automated comments, or spam links

- Harassment, intimidation, or coordinated reporting campaigns

- Misrepresenting an affiliation with the company

- Publishing false allegations about competitors

- Promising guaranteed removals or guaranteed ranking results



Candidates should be comfortable disclosing a company affiliation when required by a platform or when the relationship would materially affect how readers interpret a recommendation.



PERFORMANCE MEASURES

- Movement of priority negative URLs in branded search results

- Growth of legitimate positive and neutral assets on page one

- Quality and relevance of community participation

- Reputation risks identified before they escalate

- Accuracy and completeness of weekly reporting

- Quality of content, profile, and placement recommendations

- Compliance with company and community guidelines



Search-result suppression isn't guaranteed and may require several months, depending on the authority of the negative result and the competitiveness of the branded search.



WORK ARRANGEMENT

- Remote, part-time contractor position

- 20 hours per week to start, Monday to Friday, 4 hours a day. Hours can increase up to 40 based on performance and workload

- Your 4 hours fall within 7:00 AM to 3:30 PM US Pacific Time (10:00 PM to 6:30 AM Philippine Time). The exact block is set with your manager once you start

- Paid through Wise, on schedule

- Weekly progress reporting is required

- Some daily monitoring of brand mentions and community discussions may be needed

- During the initial training period, public responses and activity in new communities need approval before they go out



A NOTE ON APPLYING

If you have not done something, just say so in your answers. "I have not done that" costs you nothing here. What does count against you is describing work you did not personally do.



The role starts at 20 hours and can grow to 40, with the rate reviewed as the scope grows.



HOW TO APPLY

Apply through OnlineJobs.ph or
 
 NOT apply to 



Put COVERLAND at the start of your application, either in the subject line or as the first line of your message. Then answer all five questions below. Applications that skip questions, or answer in general terms without specific examples, will not be reviewed.



1. Brand and Project Scope

Describe one brand for which you personally handled online reputation management. Include:

- The industry or business type

- The month and year you started and finished

- Your exact responsibilities

- The number of negative results appearing within the first two pages of Google when you started

- Whether you worked independently or as part of a team

You may omit or anonymize the brand name if required by a confidentiality agreement.



2. Search-Result Movement

Choose one negative URL from that project and provide:

- The type of website on which it appeared

- Its approximate starting Google position

- Its approximate ending position

- The amount of time required

- The specific tactics you personally implemented

- How you tracked and verified the ranking movement

Do not claim that a result was suppressed if it only moved temporarily or disappeared because of a search-location change.



3. Community Forum Experience

Describe one forum or online-community situation you personally managed. Include the type of community, what you posted or recommended, whether you disclosed the brand relationship, and the outcome.



4. Strategy Scenario

A negative forum discussion ranks fourth when someone searches for a company's brand name. The discussion is several years old, but the forum has strong authority and the thread still receives occasional comments.

Explain how you would evaluate the result and what you would prioritize during the first 30, 60, and 90 days. Identify anything you would avoid doing and explain why.



5. Tools and Reporting

List the SEO, monitoring, community, and reporting tools you've used, and what you would include in a weekly ORM report. If available, attach a redacted example of a report or ranking tracker you personally prepared.



Please attach your resume.



Shortlisted candidates will be invited to a two-hour assessment. It is paid, whether or not you move forward.

title: Remote Sales Closer - You Sell Our Ad Service TO Car Detailers | Base + Commission
description:
ABOUT UNDER7AKE

Under7ake is a Meta ads agency that works only with car detailers. We run ads that bring local car owners to a detailer's shop, and we back it with a guarantee: 10 booked appointments in the first 30 days, or we work for free. Our main package is $997 per month. We are a growing team and we need someone to talk to detailers and bring them on as clients.

 

THE ROLE

Part-time | Remote | US Central Time (4pm-9pm)

You will run one-call discovery-and-close video calls with detailers who have applied through our ads. Our system books calls in your calendar for you and you have to attend every appointment on the calendar.

Your job:

- Run the call using our script and offer

- Confirm the detailer's city is open and that they are a fit

- Explain the package and the guarantee clearly and honestly

- Close the sale and get payment started

- Update every lead in our CRM (GoHighLevel)

- During no call slots, you will help with lead follow-ups, or no-show follow-ups.

 

You are an independent contractor, not an employee. You are responsible for your own taxes and government contributions (SSS, PhilHealth, Pag-IBIG).

We expect you to attend to every booked call, and to update the CRM after every call.

 

YOUR HOURS

Calls are booked around the detailer's day, and detailers are usually out on jobs at midday. So calls cluster in one window:

- Late afternoon and evening, after the detailer finishes: about 4pm to 9pm US Central.

We will track what works best in your first weeks and set a regular weekly schedule from that. Expect about 30 hours a week, in blocks of about 5 hours. Calls are booked ahead of time, so you will know your schedule at least 24 hours in advance. You must be able to take these windows.

 

WHAT YOU NEED

- Has experience working US Central time

- Clear, confident spoken English (A+)

- Real experience in customer sales closing video calls. Experience matters more than a title.

- Comfortable handling objections and saying no to a bad-fit client

- Reliable internet + Back-up internet, a quiet space, good computer and a good headset.

- Experience with GoHighLevel or another CRM, Google Meet or Zoom, and overall good with technology.

 

NICE TO HAVE

- Experience with selling for a SMMA, or Marketing Agency. (More Points)

- Knowledge of cars or detailing.

 

PAY

- Base: $300 per month for your first 60 days, then $250 per month

- Commission per close, paid after the client's first payment clears. Your total closes in the month set your rate, and that rate applies to ALL of your closes that month:

  1 to 4 closes in a month: $200 each

  5 to 8 closes in a month: $300 each

  9 or more closes in a month: $350 each



  Example: 9 closes = 9 x $350 = $3,150 in commission.



- Discretionary December bonus after 3 or more months

- Paid monthly through Wise. We cover the transfer fee.

Commission is reversed if the client refunds within 30 days of their first payment.



EXPECTATION:

A good candidate should be able to close AT LEAST 4 sales per month. Which would earn you $1,050/mo

An overperfomring candidate should be closing 9+ sales per month. Which would earn you $3,400/mo



GROWTH

Top performers can move up to a higher commission tier or a team lead role as we add closers.

 

HOW THE TRIAL WORKS

You start with a paid 30-day trial and a clear target we agree on in writing before you begin. We train you on the offer, the script and the CRM.

 

HOW TO APPLY

Send all of these with your application:

1. A 60-second video introducing yourself, in English and talk about your experience in remote closing sales video calls

2. Your Resume in pdf

3. If you've read the job description to this point, title your application message: "REMOTE".

 

We reply to every application that complies with all 3 application tasks above.

title: AI UGC Video Editor + Ad Creative Designer (Direct Response)
description:
About the role



We're a small performance marketing agency running Meta ads for e-commerce brands. We need a high volume of ad creative — short-form UGC-style video and statics — produced fast.



This is not a brand design job. No logos, no brand guidelines. Every asset has one job: stop the scroll and sell. If you enjoy testing ten hooks to find the one that wins, you'll like this role.



We use Arcads for AI UGC generation, so you don't need to solve AI actor consistency. What we need is someone who can write scripts that perform in that format and turn the raw output into ads that convert.



Heads up on our client mix: we work in regulated categories including CBD, nicotine alternatives, spirits, and supplements. If you're not comfortable making ads in those categories, this isn't the right fit and that's completely fine.



What you'll do



Produce 15–25 new ad creatives per week (mix of statics and 15–30 second videos)

Write UGC scripts and hooks, generate videos in Arcads, then edit them into finished ads

Post-production: cutting, pacing, captions, b-roll, screen recordings, sound design

Design static ads — product on background, comparison charts, testimonial cards, before/after

Composite real client product photos into AI-generated scenes so labels and packaging stay accurate

Build modular creative — multiple hooks, bodies, and CTAs that recombine into variants

Iterate on winners based on performance data we send you weekly

Keep a clean, organized asset library and naming system



You must have



Real experience editing short-form UGC-style ads. Portfolio required.

Strong hook writing — you can take one product and write ten different opening lines

CapCut, Premiere, or After Effects fluency: captions, jump cuts, pacing, sound

Photoshop or equivalent for compositing and retouching

Understanding of direct response fundamentals: pattern interrupts, social proof, CTA placement

Fast turnaround — same-day or next-day on most requests

Conversational written English and clear daily communication

Willingness to track hours with time tracking software



Nice to have



Direct Arcads experience (if not, you'll pick it up in a day — but tell us what you've used instead)

AI image tools: Midjourney, Flux, Nano Banana, Seedream

Familiarity with Meta ad policy and what gets creative rejected

Experience with restricted or regulated verticals

Experience reading ad metrics (CTR, hook rate, hold rate, CPA)



What we offer



Long-term, stable work with a small team

Paid twice a month, on time, every time

No micromanaging — clear briefs, clear deadlines, you own the output

Rate increases based on results, reviewed at 3 and 6 months



How to apply



Applications that don't follow these steps will be ignored.

title: AI Video Creator & Short-Form Editor for TikTok/Reels Ads
description:
We are building **Kreo AI**, a new AI image and video generation mobile app.



Kreo AI helps users create AI videos, AI images, photo-to-video effects, AI dance videos, image edits, and viral social media content.



We are looking for a creative **AI Video Creator & Short-Form Editor** who can generate high-quality AI image/video assets and turn them into jaw-dropping short-form videos for TikTok, Instagram Reels, YouTube Shorts, Meta ads, and TikTok ads.



This is not a general VA role. This role is focused on **AI content creation, short-form editing, and ad creative production**.



## Main Goal of the Role



Your main job is to create high-quality short-form video creatives using AI-generated assets.



You should be able to:



1. Generate AI images/videos using AI tools

2. Create strong visual concepts

3. Edit the assets into TikTok/Reels-style videos

4. Add hooks, captions, text overlays, music, and CTA

5. Create multiple creative variations for testing



We want videos that feel viral, modern, fast-paced, and suitable for TikTok/Reels/Meta ads.



## Responsibilities



### 1. AI Image & Video Asset Creation



You will create AI-generated assets for Kreo AI content and ads.



Examples:



* AI photo-to-video transformations

* AI dance/motion effects

* Cinematic AI videos

* AI portrait transformations

* AI image edits

* Before/after transformation assets

* App-style result demos

* Viral AI effect examples

* AI-generated visuals for ad creatives



Preferred AI tools:



* Kling

* Runway

* Seadance

* Google Veo

* Higgsfield

* ChatGPT / Claude for prompts



You do not need to know every tool, but you should be comfortable learning and testing AI tools quickly.



---



### 2. Short-Form Video Editing



You will turn AI assets into high-quality 9:16 videos for:



* TikTok

* Instagram Reels

* YouTube Shorts

* Meta Ads

* TikTok Ads



Editing should include:



* strong hook in the first 1–2 seconds

* fast pacing

* before/after reveal

* text overlays

* captions

* clean transitions

* music/sound effects

* result-first edits

* CTA ending

* mobile-first format



---



### 3. Ad Creative Production



You will create ad-style videos that can be tested on Meta and TikTok.



Example ad concepts:



* “One photo became this AI video”

* “AI turned my selfie into a movie scene”

* “Upload photo ? choose effect ? get result”

* “AI made my photo dance”

* “This is what AI can do with one image”

* “Create AI photos and turn them into videos”



The videos should be clear, exciting, and easy to understand even without sound.



---



### 4. Creative Variations



You will create multiple versions of the same concept for testing.



For example:



* different hooks

* different first 2 seconds

* different captions

* different thumbnail/cover text

* different CTA

* different music/sound

* different pacing

* different AI result examples



We are not looking for one single video only. We need someone who can create many testable creative variations.



---



### 5. Reference-Based Editing



We may provide reference videos or competitor ad examples.



Your job is to understand the structure and create an original Kreo version.



Important: We do not want to copy other brands exactly. We want to use inspiration and create original content for Kreo AI.



---



## Required Skills



* Strong short-form video editing skills

* Experience editing TikTok/Reels/Shorts

* Experience with CapCut or similar editing tools

* Good sense of pacing, hooks, and retention

* Ability to create before/after transformation videos

* Ability to add clean text overlays and captions

* Ability to create ad-style videos

* Ability to follow creative references

* Ability to generate or work with AI image/video assets

* Good communication

* Organized file delivery

* Ability to meet deadlines



---



## Nice-to-Have Skills



* Experience with AI video tools like Kling, Runway, Seadance, Veo, or Higgsfield

* Experience with AI image tools like Midjourney, DALL·E, or Leonardo

* Experience creating Meta ads or TikTok ads

* Experience with UGC-style ad creatives

* Experience promoting apps or SaaS products

* Experience with Premiere Pro / After Effects

* Experience writing hooks and captions

* Experience researching competitor ads



---



## Tools



Preferred tools:



* CapCut

* Canva

* Adobe Premiere Pro

* After Effects

* Photoshop

* Google Drive

* Google Sheets

* Notion



AI tools that are useful:



* Kling

* Runway

* Google Veo

* Higgsfield

* Seadance

* ChatGPT

* Claude



---



## Work Arrangement



This can start as a paid trial or part-time role.



If the quality is strong, this can become a long-term role.



Please include your expected rate for:



1. Part-time monthly work (4-5 hours/Day)

2. Full-time monthly work (8 hours/Day)



---



## Paid Trial Task



Before hiring long term, selected candidates will complete a paid trial.



For the trial, we will provide:



* one reference video format

* one AI photo/video concept

* basic brand direction for Kreo AI



Your task:



1. Create one 10–15 second vertical ad creative

2. Generate or prepare the AI visual/video asset

3. Add a strong hook in the first 1–2 seconds

4. Use fast pacing and clean captions

5. Show before/after or result reveal clearly

6. Add a CTA at the end

7. Provide 3 alternative hook options

8. Provide 3 thumbnail/cover text options

9. Explain which tools you used



The final video should feel suitable for TikTok, Instagram Reels, YouTube Shorts, Meta Ads, and TikTok Ads.



---



## Example Creative Direction



Example concept:



**Normal photo ? AI cinematic video transformation**



Possible structure:



1. Show final AI result first for 1 second

2. Show original photo

3. Show “AI generating” or quick transition

4. Reveal the AI video result

5. Add CTA: “Try Kreo AI” / “Join early access”



---



## Who We Are Looking For



We are looking for someone who is:



* creative

* fast

* detail-oriented

* strong at short-form editing

* interested in AI content

* able to create high-quality visual results

* comfortable experimenting with AI tools

* able to create multiple ad variations

* able to follow instructions and improve based on feedback



We are not looking for basic admin support. We are looking for someone who can help create high-quality AI video ads and viral short-form content.



---



## How to Apply



Please send:



1. Your portfolio link

2. 3 best short-form videos you edited

3. Any AI-generated videos/images you created

4. Any ad creatives you edited

5. Tools you use for AI generation and editing

7. Your expected monthly rate for part-time work

“If you were creating an ad for an AI photo-to-video app, how would you structure the first 5 seconds?”

Strong video editing skills

title: Sales & Client Relations Specialist
description:
# Sales & Client Relations Specialist



**Full-Time | Remote | US Market | Excellent English & Strong Sales Skills Required**



**Company:** Kynetik — by Nova AI Labs  

**Industry:** Consumer App Growth / Digital Marketing  

**Location:** Remote — Philippines  

**Compensation:** Competitive base salary + performance incentives, based on experience



## About Kynetik



Kynetik is a growth service operated by Nova AI Labs, an Australian technology company.



We help consumer apps grow through creative strategy, short-form content production, TikTok and Instagram distribution, and continuous performance testing.



We're looking for a **highly persuasive, confident, and results-driven Sales & Client Relations Specialist** who can turn interested prospects into qualified sales opportunities and build strong relationships with our clients.



**This is not a typical administrative or virtual assistant role. We need someone who knows how to SELL.**



## Key Responsibilities



### 1. Sales Pitching & Lead Conversion



- Engage with inbound leads generated through Meta advertising, website inquiries, and other marketing channels.

- Confidently explain and pitch Kynetik's services to consumer app founders and business owners.

- Understand each prospect's challenges and clearly communicate how Kynetik can address them.

- Deliver compelling, natural, and personalized sales pitches through
, messaging, and video calls.

- Build trust, create interest, and communicate the value of our services.

- Handle common objections about pricing, effectiveness, competition, and expected results.

- Identify buying signals and move interested prospects toward the next step.

- Follow up strategically to improve conversions.

- Conduct initial discovery conversations and book qualified strategy calls with the founder.



### 2. Lead Qualification & Appointment Setting



- Qualify prospects based on their product, business goals, marketing requirements, and purchasing readiness.

- Prioritize high-quality prospects rather than simply increasing appointment numbers.

- Schedule and confirm strategy calls.

- Maintain professional communication before and after meetings.

- Follow up with leads who have not responded or have missed appointments.

- Ensure every qualified lead receives timely attention.



### 3. Client Relations & Communication



- Maintain professional relationships with existing clients.

- Respond promptly to routine customer inquiries.

- Communicate approved campaign updates and reports.

- Collect feedback and identify potential concerns.

- Manage follow-ups and support customer retention.

- Escalate important commercial decisions or client issues directly to the founder.



### 4. CRM & Sales Pipeline Management



- Maintain accurate lead and client records.

- Track prospects through each stage of the sales pipeline.

- Monitor follow-up schedules and pending decisions.

- Record objections, customer requirements, and sales opportunities.

- Prepare daily lead updates and weekly sales performance reports.



## Essential Requirements



### Excellent Sales & Persuasion Skills — Critical



We are looking for someone who can:



- Sell confidently without sounding aggressive or desperate.

- Understand customer pain points and position a solution effectively.

- Deliver a structured, compelling sales pitch.

- Ask intelligent discovery questions.

- Build rapport quickly with founders and decision-makers.

- Handle objections calmly and persuasively.

- Communicate value instead of relying on discounts.

- Guide conversations toward a clear next step.

- Follow up consistently without sounding robotic.

- Demonstrate genuine confidence during customer conversations.



**Previous experience in B2B sales, appointment setting, sales development, or consultative selling is strongly preferred.**



### Exceptional English Communication — Mandatory



- Near-native fluency in spoken and written English.

- Natural, confident, articulate communication suitable for US business customers.

- Excellent grammar, vocabulary, listening comprehension, and conversational skills.

- Ability to communicate persuasively without reading from scripts.

- Professional written communication with appropriate tone and clarity.

- Ability to think quickly and respond naturally during live sales conversations.



An accent is not a d
 factor. Clarity, fluency, confidence, and persuasive ability are what matter.



### Professional Experience



- Experience working with US or other international clients.

- Familiarity with CRM and appointment scheduling tools.

- Strong organizational and follow-up skills.

- Comfortable using Google Workspace and online communication platforms.

- Ability to work independently and meet performance expectations.

- Reliable internet connection and a suitable environment for professional calls.



**Preferred Experience**



- Digital marketing or agency sales

- Consumer apps, SaaS, or technology services

- Selling monthly service retainers

- Lead conversion from Meta advertising

- Sales discovery calls and objection handling

- Customer relationship management



## Reporting Structure & Authority



You will report directly to the founder.



This position focuses on sales, lead qualification, and client relationships.



You will not manage our creative team, assign production tasks, control publishing accounts, or make independent pricing and contractual commitments.



You may present approved services and sales proposals, but final commercial agreements and exceptions require founder approval.



## Working Hours



- Availability overlapping US business hours

- Consistent schedule agreed during hiring



## Performance Expectations



Your performance will be measured through:



- Number of qualified leads

- Qualified strategy calls booked

- Appointment attendance rate

- Lead-to-appointment conversion rate

- Quality of sales conversations

- Consistency and effectiveness of follow-ups

- CRM accuracy

- Customer satisfaction

- Contribution to closed sales and client retention



We value meaningful sales results—not just the number of messages sent.



## How to Apply



Please submit the following:



### 1. Professional Introduction



Describe your previous sales experience, including the products or services you have sold and the types of customers you have worked with.



### 2. English & Sales Pitch Video — Mandatory



Record a **2-minute video in English**.



Scenario:



You are speaking with a US-based consumer app founder who has launched an app but is struggling to attract users.



Introduce yourself as a representative of Kynetik and deliver a convincing sales pitch explaining why the founder should consider our services.



Your pitch should demonstrate:



- Confidence

- Natural English fluency

- Persuasive communication

- Understanding of customer pain points

- Clear explanation of value

- A compelling invitation to book a strategy call



**Do not simply read a script. We want to see how naturally and confidently you sell.**



### 3. Objection Handling — Mandatory



Respond to these three customer objections:



**Objection 1:** "We already have someone creating social media content for us. Why would we need Kynetik?"



**Objection 2:** "How do I know your service will actually help us get app downloads?"



**Objection 3:** "Your service sounds expensive. Why shouldn't I just hire a freelancer?"



Provide concise, persuasive responses in your own words.



### 4. Experience & Availability



Include:



- Years of sales experience

- Experience with US customers

- Previous sales achievements, where available

- Expected monthly salary in USD

- Full-time availability

- Earliest available start date



## Our Selection Process



Shortlisted candidates will participate in a live sales role-play interview.



We will evaluate your ability to understand a customer's needs, deliver a convincing sales pitch, handle objections, and guide the conversation toward a next step.



**We are looking for a strong salesperson—not simply someone who speaks good English.**



If you are confident, persuasive, articulate, organized, and enjoy selling valuable services to business owners, we'd love to hear from you.



**Kynetik — by Nova AI Labs**

title: Content & Growth Manager — Social Media, Community and Lead Generation
description:
We are looking for an experienced Content & Growth Manager to run the day-to-day content, social-media, community-engagement and lead-management system for three established businesses in British Columbia, Canada.

The businesses operate in separate markets:

 1. A Victoria-area real-estate business serving homeowners, buyers, sellers, relocators, upsizers and downsizers.

 2. A custom-home and major-renovation company serving homeowners, landowners, architects, REALTORS and developers.

 3. A civil excavation company building relationships with developers, estimators, general contractors and other industry partners.

These are three separate brands. They must maintain distinct audiences, voices, graphics, content calendars, folders and public identities. This is not a cross-promotion role.

You will not be expected to film and edit every piece of content yourself. You will coordinate with an owner, director, videographer and editor. Your job is to make the complete marketing system work: research, planning, briefing, coordination, writing, publishing, engagement, lead capture, CRM handoff and performance reporting.

We are not looking for someone who measures success only by how many posts were published. We want someone who understands that content should build trust, start useful conversations and create qualified business opportunities.

What you will own

 ◦ Maintain one master production calendar and three separate brand calendars.

 ◦ Research each audience, local market, competitors, search behaviour and useful content opportunities.

 ◦ Turn the owner's knowledge, opinions, project access and recorded footage into clear content briefs.

 ◦ Coordinate deadlines and deliverables with the director, videographer and editor.

 ◦ Adapt approved content appropriately for
, Instagram, YouTube, LinkedIn and other selected channels.

 ◦ Manage routine comments, direct messages and community interaction in the correct brand voice.

 ◦ Monitor relevant local and industry conversations and identify appropriate opportunities to engage.

 ◦ Ask initial qualification questions, capture contact information and route genuine leads quickly.

 ◦ Maintain accurate lead source, status, notes and follow-up information in the CRM.

 ◦ Maintain organized content libraries, brand assets, permissions, passwords and reusable templates.

 ◦ Produce concise weekly reporting on completed work, audience response, leads, appointments and lessons.

 ◦ Recommend experiments based on evidence and follow them through to a measurable conclusion.

The three content programs

Capital City Group — Real Estate

The primary audience is homeowners in Victoria and the Capital Regional District who may be upsizing, downsizing, selling or relocating. Additional audiences include buyers, first-time buyers, investors and developers.

Content should emphasize:

 ◦ Local property and market intelligence

 ◦ Moving, selling and buying strategy

 ◦ Victoria-area communities and lifestyle

 ◦ Negotiation and transaction knowledge

 ◦ Construction and property-condition insight

 ◦ Selective personal content that supports trust without turning the brand into a lifestyle account

The brand's service promise is: Choose Experience, Expect Results.

Footprint — Custom Homes and Renovations

The audience includes homeowners, landowners, people searching for land, REALTORS, architects, designers and developers. Typical projects are substantial custom builds and renovations.

Content should emphasize:

 ◦ How homes are actually designed and built

 ◦ Cost, process and transparency

 ◦ Diagnosing construction problems

 ◦ Practical solutions and case studies

 ◦ Design-build and preconstruction decisions

 ◦ Evidence of meticulous, capable execution

Footprint must remain publicly separate from the real-estate brand.

Argus Excavating — Civil Construction

The objective is to strengthen Argus's professional civil-contractor presence, build relationships with estimators, general contractors and developers, increase invitations to tender and generate repeat work.

Content should demonstrate:

 ◦ Capabilities, equipment and crews

 ◦ Civil work and site-servicing knowledge

 ◦ Project planning and problem-solving

 ◦ Safety, professionalism and execution

 ◦ Project progress and completed work

 ◦ Credibility with commercial and development partners

What the owner retains

The owner will provide subject-matter expertise, opinions, access to properties and jobsites, and approval of sensitive material. The owner will also handle qualified sales conversations, estimates, negotiations and closing.

You must flag technical, financial, legal, client-sensitive or reputation-sensitive statements for approval. You will be expected to organize content into efficient approval batches rather than requesting scattered approvals throughout every day.

Required qualifications

 ◦ At least three years of relevant social-media, content-marketing or digital-growth experience

 ◦ Demonstrated responsibility for strategy and execution, not scheduling alone

 ◦ Excellent written and spoken English

 ◦ Experience managing more than one brand, client or audience at the same time

 ◦ Strong content-calendar, project-management and deadline-management skills

 ◦ Experience with community management and professional direct-message communication

 ◦ Experience qualifying leads and maintaining a CRM or equivalent lead-management system

 ◦ Ability to interpret analytics and explain what should change as a result

 ◦ Strong judgment, attention to detail and willingness to take ownership

 ◦ Reliable computer, high-speed internet and professional remote-work environment

Helpful but not mandatory

 ◦ Experience in real estate, construction, home improvement, civil contracting or professional services

 ◦ Familiarity with Follow Up Boss or another sales CRM

 ◦ Basic short-form video editing, clipping, thumbnail or graphic-design skills

 ◦ Experience coordinating videographers, editors or creative contractors

 ◦ Familiarity with email marketing, local SEO and YouTube optimization

 ◦ Experience working with Canadian, American, Australian or British clients

What success looks like

Within 90 days, you will have:

 ◦ Established reliable, separate workflows for all three brands

 ◦ Created organized calendars and content libraries

 ◦ Maintained a consistent publishing and engagement cadence

 ◦ Reduced the owner's administrative involvement in content production

 ◦ Implemented prompt and accurate lead capture and routing

 ◦ Produced reporting that connects content and conversations to qualified opportunities

 ◦ Demonstrated that you can identify problems, recommend solutions and follow through

How to apply

Start your application with the words THREE DISTINCT BRANDS so we know you read the complete posting.

Include:

 1. A short explanation of why this role fits your experience.

 2. Links to two or three accounts or campaigns you personally helped manage.

 3. For each example, explain exactly what you personally owned and what someone else produced.

 4. One example of content or engagement that produced a measurable business result.

 5. The tools you use for calendars, scheduling, analytics, CRM and team coordination.

 6. Your desired monthly salary in Philippine pesos.

 7. Your available working hours and the amount of daily Pacific Time overlap you can provide.

 8. A 60–90 second video introduction. Production quality is not important; clarity and communication are.

Do not send a generic cover letter. Shortlisted applicants will complete a paid practical exercise and attend a structured video interview.

title: Fresh Graduates — No Experience Necessary — Support Role, Global Media Business
description:
Your first real career, in a global YouTube network. Multiple positions.



START YOUR CAREER HERE

We give hungry graduates their start — and we invest properly in the ones who show us they're worth it. If you're ready to work hard, learn fast, and build a career, keep reading.



WHO YOU'D BE JOINING



MrYouWho — a global tech-media network:

- 280,000+ subscribers across 16 channels

- Millions of views

- Partnerships with major international brands

- Growing fast, and building our team from the ground up



WHY THIS SUITS A GRADUATE



- No experience necessary — we prefer it. University projects, internships and OJT all count.

- Everything runs on clear, documented processes and simple tools. We've built the system — we'll train you on it.

- We'd rather teach someone fresh our way than hire someone with bad habits.

- We're not after experience. We're after good people — reliable, hungry, and willing to think.



WHO WE'RE LOOKING FOR



Graduates (or graduating soon), ideally in Media, Communications, Marketing or Business — but attitude matters more than your field. A genuine interest in YouTube and social media stands out.



We want people who are:



- Reliable above all — turn up, follow the process, never cut corners

- Thinkers — you follow the process AND use your head. If something's obviously wrong, you catch it. You own the work being right, not just done.

- Owners of their learning — keen, self-driven, all-in. The more you give, the more we give back.

- Detail-focused — follow a checklist exactly, don't skip steps

- Able to commit to regular, set hours



We are NOT looking for:



- People who've worked for several years — these roles are to train fresh talent, so please don't apply

- Flashy CVs or big-word applications — we want genuine, keen people who want to work, not people who are good at selling themselves



THE WORK



- Schedule and publish content across our YouTube channels and socials (using tools like Metricool)

- Follow our process exactly — right platform, right format, links where specified, each post done properly and separately

- Track your work, hit daily deadlines, flag anything unclear rather than guessing

- Use judgement — never push out something obviously wrong just because the steps said so

- Grows into localisation, Social Media, Editing, SEO, thumbnails, blogs and content for those who deliver - We literally have endless work.



High-output from day one. Real volume, straight away — no coasting, no easing in.



- Sit back or work on autopilot? This isn't for you.

- Work hard, learn fast, think, and get rewarded for it? This is a genuine opportunity.



When you join, you're not just a contractor — you become a YouWhoer, part of a team building something real.



WHAT YOU NEED



- A quiet place to work

- A reliable computer

- Strong, stable internet

- Excellent written and spoken English

- Comfortable being tracked with
 software (standard for these roles)

- Able to commit to regular set shifts — not fitting this around other clients



PAY & HOURS



- Starting rate US $3.00/hour, paid in PHP at the current exchange rate

- A genuine starting point — rises to $4 and beyond as you prove reliable, accurate and capable

- Increases earned through results, not negotiated

- Contract role, up to 40 hrs/week, starting part-time and scaling as you prove consistent



FIRST STEP



A short assessment to test your written and thinking skills. It's how we see how you approach work — so put the effort in.



HOW TO APPLY



Read carefully — applications that don't follow this won't be read.



1. Put your DEGREE and GRADUATION DATE (or expected date) in the SUBJECT LINE

 (e.g. "MARKETING GRADUATE" or "COMMUNICATIONS — GRADUATING 2026")

 If you don't do this we won't open the application



2. Answer these in your OWN WORDS — not a stock AI answer, we can tell:



 - Why do you want to work with us specifically, and what would you bring? Be genuine, not generic.

 - Look up our channel — MrYouWho on YouTube. Watch a few videos, then tell us honestly: what do we actually do, and one specific thing you noticed about how we make our videos.

 - Describe a time you spotted a mistake or problem others missed, and what you did about it.

 - What regular hours can you commit to each week, and are you currently working or studying anything else?

 - Anything else that makes you a standout and gives us a reason to reply — surprise us.



3. At the very END of your application, write the word SCHEDULE so we know you read this properly.



Anyone we think is interesting, we'll reply to with a few more questions.



We won't reply if steps not followed.



We're genuinely excited to find the right people and bring them into the team. Bring the one thing we can't teach — passion — and we'll teach you everything else.



We'd love to hear from you.

We need a confident English-speaking caller to ring UK plumbers, explain the service in plain words, and help them sign up. You would be our first caller, working directly with the founder.



WHAT YOU'LL DO

- Call small UK plumbing and heating businesses (business to business) from our own calling system in your web browser. We give you the businesses to call, a UK phone number and a clear script.

- Explain the service in two minutes, answer questions, and help them sign up or book a call back.

- Send follow-up texts from the system when they ask for one.

- Record what happened after each call.



PAY

- Plus US$65 for every business that signs up and pays through your sign-up link.

- Paid monthly through OnlineJobs.ph EasyPay.

HOURS (UK business hours, Philippine evenings)

YOU'LL NEED

HOW WE WORK

title: YouTube Content Specialist
description:
Skills to Change Institute · Work from home · Results-based hours



Who I am, and what this is

I’m Robert Gene, founder of the Skills to Change Institute and creator of eutaptics® and FasterEFT™ methods. For more than thirty years, I have used this method to help people address a wide range of long-standing problems, including addictions, relationship difficulties, emotional distress, pain, sleep problems, food and chemical intolerances, money-related patterns, limiting beliefs, and a lot more.



About the Role

I am looking for an experienced YouTube Content Specialist to help transform an established YouTube channel with 2,600+ existing videos into a well-structured, optimized platform that reaches new audiences and generates new customers. The channel focuses on the personal transformation methods eutaptics® and FasterEFT™ and contains a large library of educational and training content.

I'm looking for someone who understands YouTube growth, analytics, content optimization, and video repurposing.



What You'll Do

- Learn the Method: Complete paid training and selected Skills to Change courses to understand the method, terminology, audience, and my communication style.

- Weekly Content Production: Use Robert’s ongoing live calls and Q&As as source material to create 1 strong long-form YouTube video per week from a selected question-and-answer segment, and repurpose it into 2–3 engaging YouTube Shorts 

- Audit & Strategy: Analyze the channel and YouTube Analytics to identify what works, uncover high-potential content, and prioritize which videos to optimize first.

- Optimize Existing Content: Improve titles, descriptions, thumbnails, chapters, playlists, end screens, internal linking, and calls to action based on search intent and performance data.

- Create Shorts & Reels: Find strong hooks and moments within existing long-form videos and turn them into engaging short-form content, ideally using OpusClip. Content may also be repurposed for Instagram,
, TikTok, and other relevant platforms.

- Visual Design: Create effective YouTube thumbnails and simple on-brand graphics using Canva or similar tools.

- Track & Improve: Monitor CTR, retention, watch time, search performance, traffic sources, and subscriber growth, and continuously improve the strategy based on results.

- Drive Growth & Conversion: Help turn viewers into followers and customers by creating effective content journeys: Short → Long-form Video → Related Content → Website / Training / Program.



Who I'm Looking For

Someone who is experienced, organized, reliable, accountable, and able to work independently. You should be genuinely curious about personal development and human behavior and willing to understand the work behind the content. I am looking for someone interested in a long-term collaboration.



Skills You Need

Proven experience growing or optimizing YouTube channels, with examples or measurable results.

Strong understanding of YouTube Analytics, SEO, search intent, CTR, retention, and watch time.

Experience with long-form content and creating engaging Shorts/Reels.

Solid video editing skills.

Ability to create effective thumbnails using Canva or similar tools.

Strong written English.

Strong analytical and organizational skills.

Comfortable using AI tools to work efficiently without replacing strategic thinking and creativity.



Nice to Have

Experience in coaching, wellness, personal development, or related fields

Experience with OpusClip, CapCut, or similar video editing tools



What you get

A long-term remote job with the opportunity to raise tied to results.

A paid onboarding and training period.

Payment twice a month, on the 1st and the 16th.

The opportunity to learn a method that may also be personally valuable to you and that you can use on yourself and the people you love for the rest of your life.



How we work

We agree on priorities, deadlines, and expected deliverables in advance. You will have flexibility in when you complete the work, but reliability, communication, and meeting agreed deadlines are essential.



You will track your working time so that every agreed hour is recorded and paid. At the end of each workday, you will submit a short update covering:

What you worked on

What you completed

What you learned

Any questions or obstacles

What you will work on next



This reporting system is designed to keep the team coordinated and identify problems early. It is not intended as micromanagement.



You should be available for an agreed amount of working-time overlap with European Central Time (10:00 AM to 2:00 PM CET daily). No graveyard shift is required.



Attendance at our weekly team meeting is required (Tuesdays, 11:00 AM CET, 1 hour). This is where we review priorities, share feedback, and keep the work moving. 



How to apply

Start your application with the word PEACE so we know you have read the complete job post. 

Please include:

- A short introduction describing your copywriting and marketing experience and why this particular role interests you (CV+motivation letter).

- Share links to YouTube accounts you have managed, grown, or contributed to. 

- Include 2-3 examples of short clips, reels, or posts you personally created. 

- List the tools and platforms you currently use for video editing, design, and scheduling (e.g., OpusClip, Canva, Metricool, etc.). 

- Please include your expected hourly rate and current weekly availability. 

- Imagine you take over an established YouTube channel with 2,600+ existing videos. What would you do during your first two weeks, and why? We are particularly interested in your thinking process. Please be specific rather than giving us a generic YouTube marketing answer.



Shortlisted applicants will be invited to complete a short test, which will also allow you to experience the type of work involved in this role.

title: Expert Bookkeeper
description:
NOW HIRING: Virtual Bookkeeper & Financial Operations Assistant

Remote | Part-Time | Flexible Hours



ABOUT US

Queen Clean is a growing residential and commercial cleaning company based in Montana, USA. We're looking for a detail-oriented, financially savvy virtual assistant with strong bookkeeping and QuickBooks experience to help us organize our finances, improve reporting, and identify opportunities to operate more efficiently.



We're looking for someone who can do more than basic data entry. We want a proactive, analytical person who can help us understand our numbers, improve financial processes, and make smarter business decisions.



KEY RESPONSIBILITIES



Bookkeeping & QuickBooks Management

- Clean up, organize, categorize, and reconcile transactions in QuickBooks Online.

- Reconcile bank accounts, credit cards, and financial records.

- Review expenses and ensure accurate financial reporting.

- Identify and correct bookkeeping discrepancies.

- Help establish organized and efficient bookkeeping systems.



Payroll & Labor Cost Analysis

- Assist with payroll administration, payroll reconciliation, and labor cost tracking.

- Calculate employee burden rates, including wages, payroll taxes, workers' compensation, benefits, and other employment costs.

- Analyze billable versus non-billable employee hours.

- Help determine the true hourly cost of employees and overall labor expenses.



Financial Analysis & Business Efficiency

- Analyze overhead, operating expenses, and business profitability.

- Identify unnecessary expenses and opportunities to reduce costs.

- Help evaluate pricing, profit margins, and the profitability of different services.

- Assist with budgeting, cash flow tracking, and financial planning.

- Create simple financial reports, spreadsheets, and dashboards to monitor key business metrics.

- Provide recommendations for improving financial efficiency and profitability.



IDEAL CANDIDATE

- Strong experience with QuickBooks Online and bookkeeping reconciliation.

- Proficient in Excel and/or Google Sheets.

- Experience with payroll and labor cost analysis.

- Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.

- Comfortable interpreting financial reports and explaining numbers in simple, understandable terms.

- Able to identify financial discrepancies and recommend improvements.

- Highly organized, detail-oriented, reliable, and trustworthy.

- Excellent communication skills and ability to work independently.

- Experience working with small businesses, service companies, or cleaning businesses is a plus.

- Experience with financial reporting, budgeting, or profitability analysis is highly desirable.



WORK SCHEDULE & AVAILABILITY

This is a remote, part-time position with flexible hours. Much of the work can be completed independently and on your own schedule, provided deadlines are met and communication is consistent.



However, we are looking for someone who can offer some availability during our regular business hours of 9:00 AM–5:00 PM Mountain Time (Montana, USA).



We would like to schedule weekly or monthly meetings, depending on business needs, to review our financials, discuss progress, address questions, and ensure our bookkeeping and financial goals are on track.



You do not need to work the entire 9–5 schedule, but you must be available for occasional meetings and real-time collaboration during those hours.



We're looking for someone who is self-motivated, works well independently, communicates proactively, and is comfortable collaborating directly with the business owner.



WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR

We don't just want someone to enter transactions. We're looking for someone who can help us understand our numbers, determine what our employees truly cost us, identify where money is being spent, and find opportunities to make the business more financially efficient.



This position will initially focus on QuickBooks cleanup and financial organization, with the potential for ongoing bookkeeping, payroll support, and financial analysis.



We value accuracy, initiative, clear communication, and someone who takes pride in helping a small business succeed.



HOW TO APPLY

If you're interested in this position, please complete our application form:







In your application message, please include:

1. Your experience with QuickBooks Online, bookkeeping, and financial reconciliation.

2. Any experience with payroll, employee burden rates, or financial analysis.

3. Examples of how you've helped a business improve financial organization, reduce expenses, or increase profitability.

4. Your time zone, typical working hours, and availability for meetings during Montana business hours.

5. Your desired hourly rate.



IMPORTANT: Please include the keyword QUEEN in your application message. This helps us identify applicants who have carefully read the job description and followed the instructions.



Applications that do not follow these instructions may not be considered.



We look forward to hearing from you!



Queen Clean | Montana, USA
