title: LinkedIn Research & Appointment Setting Specialist
description:
Remote | Part-Time | US$5/hour + 7.5% Sales Commission

10–15 hours per month | Performance-driven opportunity



Are you exceptional at finding the right people, starting meaningful conversations and getting appointments booked?



We're looking for an experienced, proactive Appointment Setting Specialist who knows how to turn thoughtful research and personalised outreach into qualified, attended appointments.



This is not a generic lead generation role.



We don't need someone to build us a marketing strategy, generate hundreds of random leads or send mass-produced messages.



We already have the strategy, the ideal client profile, the outreach framework and the messaging.



What we need is someone with the energy, initiative, persistence and commercial drive to execute it exceptionally well.



About Woman Reimagined - Woman Reimagined is a premium identity recalibration programme for accomplished women over 40 who are navigating significant transitions in their lives, careers and sense of self.



Our clients are founders, executives, entrepreneurs, creatives and leaders. These are intelligent, discerning women who have achieved a great deal and are beginning to question what they want the next chapter of their lives to look like.



The programme investment is  US$11,111.



Our founder, Elle Nagy, conducts confidential research interviews with carefully selected women to better understand their experiences, challenges, desires and aspirations.



Your responsibility is to identify the right women and invite them into these conversations.



These are genuine research interviews, not disguised sales appointments. You will not be expected to sell or close the programme.



What You'll Be Doing



- Research LinkedIn and other relevant professional networks to identify women who fit our established prospect criteria.

- Look beyond job titles and superficial profile information to recognise credible signals of a potentially relevant life or identity transition.

- Use our approved outreach framework to initiate thoughtful, personalised conversations.

- Follow up consistently, professionally and respectfully.

- Invite suitable women to confidential research interviews with our founder.

- Coordinate bookings and confirmations to maximise attendance.

- Maintain an accurate, organised record of prospects, conversations, appointments and outcomes.

- Share useful observations about response patterns and opportunities to improve execution.



Experience engaging with professional women's networks, female-founder communities, women's leadership organisations and women-centred online spaces would be particularly valuable.



Any outreach within private communities must respect their membership requirements, rules and privacy expectations.



What Success Looks Like:



Your initial minimum performance target is 4–6 qualified, attended research interviews per month.



We're interested in appointments that actually happen, with women who genuinely match our criteria and understand why they've been invited.



Quality matters enormously.



We are not interested in filling a calendar with people who have little connection to the programme's intended audience.



You will be provided with clear prospect criteria, messaging guidance and an established outreach process. Your role is to turn those resources into consistent results.



Who We're Looking For



You must have:



- Proven experience booking appointments through LinkedIn outreach, direct messaging or similar relationship-based prospecting.

- Demonstrable results from previous appointment-setting work.

- Excellent written English and the ability to communicate naturally, confidently and professionally.

- Strong research skills and sound judgment about who is worth approaching.

- The ability to personalise messages without sounding scripted, intrusive or overly familiar.

- Consistent follow-through and resilience when prospects don't respond.

- Excellent organisation and attention to detail.

- The confidence to take initiative, solve everyday problems and keep momentum moving.

- A willingness to follow an established strategy rather than constantly reinvent it.



Most importantly, you must genuinely enjoy the commercial challenge of turning outreach into opportunities.



We're looking for someone who takes ownership, loves achieving targets and is motivated by the possibility of earning significantly more through successful results.



Compensation and Earning Potential:

Base compensation: US$5 per hour

Sales commission: 7.5% on attributable Woman Reimagined enrolment revenue received by the company.



At the current programme investment of US$11,111, one full-price enrolment would generate approximately US$833.33 in commission, assuming the full programme fee is collected and commissionable.



Commission is paid as the company receives the client's payments. Where a client pays in instalments, the corresponding commission is paid on eligible instalments received, according to the commission agreement.



There is no guarantee of enrolments or commission earnings.



This opportunity is best suited to someone who values the stability of a modest hourly base but is far more excited by the earning potential of successful performance.



If your primary priority is a substantial guaranteed hourly income, this is unlikely to be the right opportunity.



If you're commercially ambitious, confident in your appointment-setting abilities and excited by performance-based earnings, we'd love to hear from you.



Hours and Working Arrangement:

- Remote

- Approximately 10–15 hours per month initially

- Flexible scheduling, with agreed reporting and communication expectations

- Opportunity for the relationship to expand as the business grows and results justify it



How to Apply:



Please answer the following questions in your application. We value specific examples and real experience more than polished, generic answers.



1. Your results



Tell us about your most relevant appointment-setting role. Who were you targeting, which channels did you use, how many appointments did you book, and what proportion attended?



2. Your prospect judgment



Imagine you find a 49-year-old woman on LinkedIn who founded and sold a successful company eight months ago. She now describes herself as an investor and board adviser.



Would you consider her a potential research-interview candidate? What would you want to understand before approaching her?



3. Your outreach ability



You've identified a woman who appears to be an excellent fit for a confidential research interview. She doesn't know Elle Nagy.



Write a short first LinkedIn message inviting her to participate. Your message should be thoughtful, natural and genuinely compelling, without pitching a coaching programme.



4. Your commercial motivation



This role offers US$5/hour plus 7.5% commission on attributable programme enrolments. What appeals to you about this structure, and what have you done in previous roles to consistently achieve or exceed appointment targets?



Applications that don't answer all four questions will not be considered.



We're looking for someone who is ready to create momentum, build meaningful connections and be rewarded for the results they help produce.



If that's you, we'd love to meet you.

- Explain account balances and patient responsibility professionally, clearly and respectfully.

- Review patient and insurance aging reports, prioritizing overdue and high-balance accounts.

- Confidence making outbound calls and discussing financial matters with patients.

- Understanding of dental insurance claims, EOBs, patient responsibility and A/R aging reports.

- Strong organization, accuracy and consistent follow-through.

- Reliable internet, a computer, a quality headset and a quiet, private workspace.

**Preferred Qualifications**



- Experience with Open Dental.

- Proven success reducing overdue dental accounts receivable.

- Experience resolving denied claims and following up with U.S. dental insurance carriers.

- Spanish fluency in addition to excellent English.



**How Success Will Be Measured**



Success means collecting outstanding balances, resolving unpaid insurance claims and reducing aged A/R. We will review dollars collected, accounts and claims resolved, follow-up completion and documentation accuracy. Account adjustments or write-offs require management approval.



**To Apply**



Please apply through this platform and include:



1. Your résumé and a summary of your U.S. dental billing and collections experience.

2. The dental software and insurance portals you have used.

3. Your country, time zone, availability and expected hourly or monthly rate.

4. A 60–90 second voice recording in English introducing yourself and explaining how you would professionally approach a patient about an overdue balance.

5. A brief example of how you helped collect an overdue balance or resolve an unpaid insurance claim. Do not include patient names or identifying information.



Selected candidates will complete a video interview and a short role-play using a fictional patient balance and insurance claim.



**We are seeking a dependable professional who takes ownership of follow-up and helps turn outstanding balances into collected revenue.**

description:
About the Role



We are looking for an experienced Customer Success & Retention Specialist to assist customers who have received an impression kit but have not yet started or completed the process.



This is a high-touch, phone-based role that combines customer support, proactive follow-up, troubleshooting, retention, and conflict resolution.



You will help customers understand the process, address their concerns, overcome obstacles, and move toward completion. You will also handle cancellation and refund requests by identifying the underlying concern and exploring appropriate solutions in line with company policies.



We are looking for someone who can balance empathy with confidence, protect the customer experience, and take ownership of each case from initial contact through resolution.



Key Responsibilities

Proactively call customers who have received their impression kits but have not started or completed the process.

Guide customers through the process using clear, patient, step-by-step instructions.

Identify reasons for delays, incomplete kits, cancellations, and refund requests.

Troubleshoot common issues and help customers overcome process-related difficulties.

Address concerns about timing, inconvenience, expectations, product confidence, and completion requirements.

Apply appropriate retention strategies to resolve concerns and prevent avoidable cancellations.

De-escalate frustrated customers while maintaining a professional and empathetic approach.

Explore realistic solutions without making promises outside company policy.

Conduct consistent follow-ups until the customer completes the process or reaches a final resolution.

Document calls, customer concerns, commitments, outcomes, and follow-up dates in the CRM.

Coordinate with internal teams regarding replacement kits, technical support, refunds, and escalations.

Identify recurring customer concerns and recommend ways to improve completion and retention.



Qualifications

Excellent spoken English with clear pronunciation, strong comprehension, and professional phone etiquette.

Previous experience in customer retention, customer success, phone support, healthcare support, complaint resolution, subscription retention, collections, or inside sales.

Strong verbal communication, active listening, and questioning skills.

Proven ability to handle objections, difficult conversations, and cancellation or refund requests.

Ability to remain calm and professional when dealing with upset or frustrated customers.

Strong problem-solving, negotiation, and conflict-resolution skills.

Empathetic but confident in guiding customers toward appropriate solutions.

Experience with CRM systems and case management is an advantage.

Excellent organization, follow-up discipline, and case ownership.

This position is best suited for experienced professionals who can build rapport quickly, uncover the real reason behind customer hesitation, and turn challenging conversations into positive outcomes.



How to Apply

To be considered, please submit BOTH of the following:



Your updated resume highlighting your relevant phone support, customer success, retention, or conflict-resolution experience.

An introduction video discussing your relevant experience, spoken English and phone communication skills, objection-handling abilities, and how you would handle a frustrated customer requesting a cancellation or refund.

If you have the confidence, patience, and customer retention skills needed to make a difference, we encourage you to apply!

title: COLD CALLER / APPOINTMENT SETTER – US Home-Service Contractors
description:
COLD CALLER / APPOINTMENT SETTER – US Home-Service Contractors | 8:00 AM – 4:00 PM US Central Time | Paid Probation → Full-Time



We're hiring confident cold callers to join our outbound team calling U.S. contractors (roofing, plumbing, HVAC, and other home-service businesses). Your job is to speak with business owners and book qualified appointments for our sales team. You don't need to close deals, just get the meeting.



SCHEDULE

8:00 AM – 4:00 PM US Central Time, Monday to Friday

(That's 9:00 PM – 5:00 AM Philippine time. From November, when US daylight saving ends, it becomes 10:00 PM – 6:00 AM PH time.)



PAY & PROBATIONARY PERIOD

Selected applicants will start with a paid probationary period at $20 per day, paid daily. You'll be working on our real dialer, real leads, and real script from day one.



If your performance is strong during the probationary period, we will offer you a full-time position with our team.



WHAT YOU'LL DO

- Make high-volume outbound calls using our dialer and lead lists (no manual dialing)

- Speak with contractor business owners and decision-makers

- Handle basic objections and book qualified appointments

- Log every call accurately at the end of each shift

- Follow our script while keeping the conversation natural



WHO WE'RE LOOKING FOR

Priority goes to applicants who have sold leads, marketing, or services to contractors, e.g. HomeAdvisor/Angi, HomeStars, Thumbtack, Yelp, Yellow Pages, Jobber, ServiceTitan, lead-gen companies, or agencies serving home-service businesses.



Strong cold callers from other industries are welcome to apply too.



REQUIREMENTS

- Clear, natural spoken English

- Cold calling / appointment setting experience

- Comfortable making a large number of calls per shift

- Reliable internet, a quiet workspace, and a good headset

- Available for the full shift, Monday to Friday



HOW TO APPLY (IMPORTANT)

Applications that don't follow these steps will not be reviewed.



1. Record a voice recording at 
 answering this scenario:



   You're cold-calling a roofing contractor named Mike. He picks up and says:

   "Hey, I'm in the middle of something. What is this about?"

  

 Respond naturally, handle his objection, and try to get him to agree to a short meeting.



   Please don't read a script word-for-word. We want to hear how you actually sound on a call.



2. Click "Save & Share" on Vocaroo and copy the link.



3. Fill out our application form here: 





We know applying takes a bit of effort, and we truly appreciate the time you put into your recording. Every application is reviewed personally, and we listen to every voice recording. If you're someone who enjoys conversations, stays positive through a busy calling day, and wants to grow with a team that rewards hard work, we'd love to hear from you. We look forward to meeting you!

title: Professional Video Editor – Advanced Manual Editing Skills Required
description:
About Us and the Role



Ice Cream Sunshine is a good vibes signature ice cream tour and special events company based in

Chicago. Good vibes, excellence, and fun are the core of who we are, and that extends to every person on

our team.



Ice Cream Sunshine is building a team of professional video editors who genuinely love the craft and bring

highly skilled hands on editing to every project. We are not looking for one person to carry the whole

workload as we produce 14 to 21 shorts / reels per week. We are building a bench of skilled, reliable editors

who collaborate well, communicate clearly, and keep our production moving to serve our audience. If you

are the kind of editor who notices the tiny details, are focused on the best storytelling through detailed

advanced editing techniques then we want to meet you.



You love to learn and you love to have fun. That is the kind of person who thrives on our team.



Good Vibes Only Company



We believe in good vibes, respect, value, appreciation, and fun as a company culture. We perform with

excellence and have a good time along the way.







CANDIDATES WHO HEAR FROM OUR TEAM

Complete a full application.  Details are found in the HOW TO APPLY section.







What You Will Do



● Edit short form videos (shorts and reels) as well as longer form content, following a Creative Brief that

varies from project to project.

● Deliver polished, professional cuts with smooth pacing, clean audio, and strong storytelling that brings

joy and information to our audience.

● Work through a structured, multi round feedback and revision process to protect quality on every final

master file.

● Collaborate closely with our Associate Producer and fellow editors to hit a production schedule of 14

to 21 videos per week.

● Bring genuine fun and expertise to every cut.



What We Need From You



● 5+ years of professional video editing experience with real clients, using Final Cut Pro, Adobe

software, or other professional editing software. This means paid, professional work, not self taught or

personal editing. CapCut and Canva do not count as professional editing tools.

● Real availability overlapping 9:00 AM to 1:00 PM Chicago time, plus attendance at our Tuesday team

meeting from 2:00 PM to 3:30 PM Chicago time.

● A sharp eye for detail, strong storytelling instincts, and the ability to take direction from a Creative Brief

and run with it.

● A collaborative, good vibes attitude. We are a team, and we look out for each other.



Important



During our first round interview we require a live editing demo to validate editing skills are in alignment with

your portfolio using manual cuts (no AI). You must be comfortable with this skills assessment to be

considered for our team. We will evaluate shot sequence and storytelling techniques based on source

footage we provide for a simple short/reel that only has the purpose of the demonstration itself.



In Your Cover Letter, Tell Us About Your Expertise In



Video Editing: Adobe Premiere Pro, DaVinci Resolve, Final Cut Pro

Motion Graphics: / VFX Adobe After Effects

Audio: Adobe Audition

Photo / Graphics: Adobe Photoshop

Other: Tell us what else you bring to the table.



REQUIRED with your Cover Letter: Share a link to a 60 to 90 second simple video where you talk about your favorite ice cream and what you love about being a video editor.



Pay and Growth



● $5 to $8 per hour to start, plus bonuses. Some bonuses are guaranteed and some are performance

based.

● A paid test project ($15 flat fee) with a 24 hour turnaround, guided by several quality checkpoints

along the way.

● Based on business needs, the following opportunities may also become available: rate increases over

time, more hours or full time work, and growth into a lead or senior editor role.



Our Hiring Process



● Apply with your resume, portfolio, and cover letter.

● Qualified candidates receive a short survey to help us understand your skills and style.

● Our first round interview includes a live editing component so we can confirm your advanced skills

together, in real time.

● We verify past work and check references as part of our process, because we want every hire to be

the real deal.



Everyone at Ice Cream Sunshine wishes you joy always and delicious ice cream too. 🍦

title: Customer Service manager Shopify Fashion Stores (Long-term job)
description:
Our Shopify fashion stores are growing fast through Google Ads. More orders means more tickets, more escalations and more supplier issues, and we need one experienced person to take charge of all of it.



You will be the person who keeps our customers happy behind the scenes. You lead the CS team, take over the difficult cases, keep our supplier in line and work directly with the founders to make the whole operation run smoother.



We are looking for someone who has done this before. If you have only worked as a support agent and never led a team, this is not the right fit.



This is a long-term role, not a project.



Your role in short



You take the hard cases

When a customer is angry, demands a refund or threatens to call their bank, the ticket lands with you. You know when to refund, when to replace and when to hold your ground, and you solve it before it turns into a dispute. You also d
 what the agents can handle on their own and what should come to you.



You lead the team

Priorities, quality of replies and response times. You coach them, write the SOPs and macros, and make sure the team works the same way every time. As we add stores, you build the team out further.



You keep orders and suppliers on track

Late shipments, wrong sizes, lost parcels, tracking that stopped updating: you follow up on all of it. You push our supplier on defects, delays and reshipments, and you spot problems before customers do.



You are the founders' right hand on the backend

You work closely with the founders and are their go-to person for everything customer service. You point out recurring problems with products, suppliers or ads, and help shape our refund and return policies.



You keep disputes low

Your main job here is prevention: solving problems before customers go to their bank or PayPal. Experience with handling disputes in Shopify Payments or PayPal is a bonus, not a must.



You report on what is happening

Once a month, per store, you share the numbers: escalations handled, refund rate, response times and dispute ratio. More importantly, you tell us what is causing the problems and what we should change.



Our setup

We communicate through Slack, both with the founders and within the team. Reporting, order tracking and supplier follow-up run in Google Sheets and Excel.



You are the right person if you



have worked as an Operations Manager, Support Manager, Backend Manager or Team Lead at an e-commerce company

have led a team and been responsible for their results

know how to calm down angry customers and prevent chargebacks

have worked with high-volume stores running paid ads

have dealt directly with suppliers

have worked with Gorgias, Zendesk or Re:amaze

are comfortable in Slack, Google Sheets and Excel

write excellent English

are flexible when urgent escalations come in



Bonus points if you



have handled chargebacks and disputes in Shopify Payments or PayPal

have worked in fashion e-commerce



What you get



A long-term, stable position that grows as we add stores

Direct collaboration with the founders

Full ownership of how customer service and backend are run



How to apply

Start your message with the word , otherwise we won't read it. Then briefly tell us your most recent management role, your team size and which helpdesk tools you have used.

Every ticket our agents escalate comes to you: angry customers, refund demands, "refund me or I'm calling my bank."

You d

title: Personal Executive Assistant / Operations & Hiring Coordinator (Healthcare Tech Startup)

title: L2 Tech Support Engineer
description:

• Bonuses- when the company wins, you win!

• Raises- As we grow, we believe you should as well. We have to stay competitive as an employer to retain our awesome employees!

• Opportunities to grow- In our industry, we can't be on "cruise control"... We need to push our team members to stay ahead of the technology curve. Help you continually sharpen your skills with a focus on your career aspirations.

You're the right fit if you:

• Want to work in a GROWING environment, with STABLE income, Bonuses, and a great attitude!

Helpdesk (mostly escalations, but some basic if needed), cyber security related tasks/ audits, cloud hosting and virtualization (HyperV, SonicWall, VPN), MS365 management and automation, BCDR (Axcient), networking (UniFi, SonicWall), IT projects, Servers maintenance (Windows only), scripts creation, testing new technology, and other tasks related to IT.



IMPORTANT:

This position requires AT LEAST 3 years of MSP experience and at least 2 years of experience in an L2 position, supervisory, or lead role. 100% clean background check, highly organized, technologically savvy, and can work diligently with little supervision. Several hiring steps will take place to verify the above requirements, including reference checking, employment verification, technical testing, and more.

MORE DETAILS:

This means we will be installing our security software on that computer, will remove admin rights from you, and monitor/ control it for security and compliance reasons. In return, we will pay you additional “rent” fees, on top of your salary, in the amount of several hundred dollars. Details about this “rental” will be discussed during your second interview. There are minimum requirements that your computer must have in order to be employed with us. You must have a Computer/Laptop with at least i5 minimum 9th gen processor (preferably a newer one) with 16 GB RAM or more, or Ryzen 5/7 (MUST include TPM support) as well as Windows 11 OS.

title: Medical Virtual Assistant, Care Coordinator & Billing Specialist
description:
Medical Virtual Assistant, Care Coordinator & Billing Specialist



MindRefined is a psychiatric and mental health practice based in Florida, USA. We use modern technology and evidence-based clinical models to provide high-quality telehealth care to patients managing ADHD, anxiety, depression, and other mental health conditions. We pride ourselves on operational excellence, smooth clinical workflows, and compassionate, timely patient care.



We are seeking a skilled, dedicated, and professional full-time Medical Virtual Assistant, Care Coordinator & Billing Specialist based in the Philippines to manage our patient communications, EHR scheduling, and medical billing and revenue cycle management (RCM) workflows.



Position Details

Role type: Full-time (40 hours per week)

Shift: Monday to Friday, 9:00 AM to 5:00 PM US Eastern Time (overnight in the Philippines)

Hourly rate: $4.00 to $6.00 USD, based on experience, qualifications, and billing expertise

Location: Remote (Philippines)

Primary systems: Tebra (formerly Kareo) EHR/PM, Dialpad (VoIP), Google Workspace

Primary Responsibilities

Call Handling, Triage & Scheduling

Live calls and triage: Answer inbound calls and make outbound calls using Dialpad. Triage clinical concerns and medication or refill requests, and route urgent messages to the psychiatric nurse practitioners (NPs).

Scheduling: Manage the live scheduling calendar in Tebra. Schedule new intakes, coordinate follow-up appointments, and proactively contact patients to resolve no-shows and scheduling conflicts.

Voi
s and texts: Monitor, transcribe, and action patient voi
s and inbound text messages daily, so that no patient outreach goes unanswered.

Medical Billing & Revenue Cycle Management

Claim review and audit: Monitor and audit claims in Tebra to ensure accurate processing and resolve outstanding balances.

Deductible and copay auditing: Run routine audits on patient deductibles and coinsurance to ensure accurate up-front collections and resolve underpayments.

Rejection and denial resolution: Read, interpret, and troubleshoot clearinghouse rejection and denial codes in Tebra, and systematically resolve billing errors.

Payment and ledger entry: Record patient payments (copays, cash-pay fees, deductibles) in Tebra and keep patient ledgers balanced.

Eligibility verification: Run electronic insurance eligibility checks, including mental health benefits, and verify active coverage before visits.

IT & Security Requirements (Strict HIPAA Compliance)



Because you will handle protected health information (PHI) and financial data, you must follow strict security protocols:



Work only within a secure, employer-provided virtual desktop (cloud computer) with printing and downloading disabled.

Have a private, quiet, and secure workspace. Public cafes and shared co-working spaces are not permitted.

Have a reliable fiber internet connection (minimum 25 Mbps download and upload), plus a backup power source (UPS or generator) or a backup mobile data connection.

Use a high-quality noise-canceling headset to maintain professional call standards on Dialpad.

Required Qualifications

Experience: At least 2 years as a medical virtual assistant and US medical biller or RCM specialist. Mental health or psychiatry experience is a strong plus.

Billing expertise: Solid understanding of US health insurance terminology, CPT and ICD-10 coding, electronic eligibility checks, clearinghouse processes, and 835 ERA denial codes.

Software skills: Proven hands-on experience with Tebra (Kareo) EHR and practice management systems.

Communication: Excellent verbal and written English, with a natural telephone presence and strong active listening skills.

Analytical skills: Strong math and logical reasoning to audit ledgers, resolve claim discrepancies, and explain insurance costs to patients.

Data security: Clear understanding of HIPAA guidelines, patient privacy, and data security standards.



Preferred, not required: Licensed Philippine Registered Nurse (PHRN) or allied health background.



What We Offer

Competitive compensation: Paid bi-weekly or monthly through secure international payment channels (e.g., Wise, Deel).

Stable, consistent hours: A fixed full-time schedule on US business hours, with no rotating shifts.

Collaborative team: Direct collaboration with psychiatric providers and practice management.

Career growth: Opportunities to lead advanced work in revenue cycle management or clinic operations.

How to Apply



Please submit:



Your updated resume.

A one-minute audio or video recording (via Vocaroo or Loom) introducing yourself, your medical billing and administrative experience, and why you are a good fit for a mental health practice.

Confirmation of whether you have used Tebra/Kareo (Yes/No).

title: Real Estate SaaS Customer Support Agent (Full-Time Remote)
description:
Company: REsimpli

Position Type: Full-Time | Remote

Schedule: Monday–Friday | 40 hours/week

Compensation: Hourly rate based on experience and qualifications



About REsimpli

REsimpli is a fast-growing SaaS company helping real estate investors streamline and scale their businesses through innovative technology. Our mission is to make real estate investing simpler by providing powerful tools, exceptional support, and a customer experience that helps our users succeed.



Role Overview

We are looking for a Customer Support Agent who is responsive, patient, detail-oriented, and genuinely enjoys helping people solve problems.



In this role, you will be responsible for providing timely and accurate support to REsimpli customers when they have questions, encounter issues, or need assistance using the platform. You will communicate with customers through live chat, email, Zoom, and other support channels to understand their needs, troubleshoot problems, provide clear solutions, and escalate issues when necessary.



You will work closely with Customer Success, Product, and other internal teams to ensure customer issues are properly documented, communicated, and resolved.



Key Responsibilities

- Respond to customer questions and support requests through live chat, email, Zoom, and other communication channels in a timely and professional manner.

- Troubleshoot product-related questions and issues and guide customers through appropriate solutions.

- Help customers understand how REsimpli features and functionality work.

- Identify the root cause of customer issues and provide clear, accurate, and easy-to-follow instructions.

- Reproduce and document issues when appropriate to help internal teams investigate and resolve them.

- Escalate bugs, technical issues, product limitations, and complex customer concerns to the appropriate internal team.

- Follow up on escalated issues when necessary and ensure customers receive appropriate updates.

- Accurately document customer conversations, reported issues, troubleshooting steps, and resolutions within company systems and CRM/support tools.

- Identify recurring customer questions or issues and communicate patterns and feedback to leadership and Product.

- Follow established support workflows, SOPs, quality standards, and escalation procedures.

- Contribute to internal documentation, help resources, FAQs, and knowledge base content based on common customer questions and issues.

- Maintain a professional, patient, and solutions-oriented approach, including when working with frustrated customers.

- Collaborate with Customer Success Managers to communicate customer issues or concerns that may impact adoption, satisfaction, or retention.



What We're Looking For

- 1–2+ years of experience in Customer Support, Technical Support, SaaS Support, or another customer-facing support role.

- Familiarity with REsimpli and/or experience using the platform.

- Experience in real estate, particularly real estate investing, wholesaling, or working with real estate investors.

- Experience supporting SaaS products, CRM platforms, or business software preferred.

- Strong written and verbal communication skills.

- Excellent troubleshooting and problem-solving abilities.

- Ability to understand a customer's problem, ask the right questions, and determine the appropriate solution or next step.

- Ability to explain technical concepts and software functionality clearly to customers with varying levels of technical experience.

- Strong attention to detail and accurate documentation habits.

- Ability to manage multiple customer conversations and support requests while remaining organized and responsive.

- Comfortable using chat, email, Zoom, CRM systems, ticketing systems, and other customer communication tools.

- Ability to remain calm, patient, and professional when handling frustrated or upset customers.

- Strong sense of ownership — you take responsibility for getting an issue to the appropriate resolution rather than simply passing it along.

- Self-motivated, dependable, and able to work independently in a remote environment.

- Willingness to learn REsimpli's product, workflows, and the needs of our real estate investor customers.



Nice to Have

- Experience supporting SaaS products or CRM platforms.

- Experience with customer support ticketing systems or help desk software.

- Experience troubleshooting software or technical issues.

- Experience working with APIs, integrations, automations, or other technical software functionality.

- Experience working with real estate investors, sales teams, or technology-based businesses.

- Experience creating or maintaining knowledge base articles, FAQs, or support documentation.



Remote Work Requirements

As a remote team member, you are expected to maintain:

- Reliable high-speed internet service.

- A professional, distraction-free workspace suitable for customer interactions.

- Equipment capable of supporting company software and video conferencing.



You will also be expected to:

- Maintain your assigned work schedule and remain available during scheduled hours.

- Respond to customer requests within established response-time expectations.

- Communicate proactively with your team and leadership.

- Follow company processes, SOPs, escalation procedures, and quality standards.

- Maintain accurate and timely documentation of customer interactions.



Benefits

Following successful completion of the introductory period, eligible team members will receive:

- Paid time off (PTO) in accordance with company policy.

- Paid holidays in accordance with company policy.



How to Apply

To be considered for this position, please submit:

1. Your resume.

2. A short introduction video recording.



Please ensure all required application materials are submitted. Incomplete applications will not be considered.



Join REsimpli and help us deliver fast, knowledgeable, and exceptional support to the real estate investors who rely on our platform every day.

About Power Plus Systems:

title: GoHighLevel Builder and Digital Marketing Specialist
description:
ABOUT INTERCEPTLY



Interceptly helps B2B companies find and start conversations with buyers who are already showing intent. We run signal-driven outbound campaigns for our clients and our partners’ clients, and we build our own intent products, including LeadIntercept, which tracks competitor engagement at the individual level.



We are a small team that runs on AI. Most of our processes live as Claude Code skills in a shared Git repo, and GoHighLevel is the center of our marketing and client operations. You will be the person who builds in it and makes it look good.



THE ROLE



This is a hands-on role split across 3 areas:



Building in GoHighLevel. You own our GHL builds: funnels, landing pages, websites, forms, automations, and reporting.

SEO. You keep our sites fast, indexed, and ranking, and you make sure every page you build is set up properly for search.

Social media and creative. You run our company social channels and create the graphics and images that go with them.



We care a lot about design. We want pages and graphics that look sharp and modern, not like a template someone forgot to finish.



WHAT YOU WILL DO



GoHighLevel builds and automation



Design and build landing pages, funnels, and full websites in GHL, from wireframe to launch

Build and maintain automation workflows: lead capture, nurture sequences, onboarding flows, follow-ups, reminders, and internal notifications

Build forms, surveys, calendars, and pipelines, and connect them so leads go to the right place

Create dashboards and reports that show leads, conversions, pipeline, and campaign performance at a glance

Set up tracking, UTM handling, and integrations so the numbers in our reports can be trusted

Keep our GHL workspaces tidy: custom fields, tags, templates, and naming conventions



SEO



Make sure every page and site you build is set up for search: meta titles and descriptions, headings, image alt text, internal links, schema, and page speed

Run regular site audits with Ahrefs or Semrush and fix what they find: broken links, redirects, canonicals, orphan pages, and missing OG images

Monitor Google Search Console for indexing and performance issues and work through the fix list

Do keyword research for new pages and content, and track rankings over time

Recommend and carry out on-page improvements to the pages that matter most to us



Social media and creative



Plan, write, and schedule posts for our company social channels on a consistent calendar

Design graphics, carousels, banners, and images for social posts, landing pages, and ads

Repurpose blog posts, case studies, and product updates into social content

Track engagement and report on what is working each month

Keep everything on brand: colors, fonts, tone of voice, and product naming



Claude Code and AI



Use Claude Code and other AI tools daily to draft copy, speed up builds, and run our internal skills

Spot manual, repeated work and turn it into an automation or a skill



A TYPICAL WEEK



Every day: share your priorities in the morning and an end-of-day update with the team. Work through GHL build and automation tasks, and publish or schedule social content.

Weekly: at least 3 to 5 social posts with original graphics, plus progress on any open page, funnel, or website builds.

title: Social Media Video Editor – Daily Lifestyle Vlogs & Reels
description:
I’m a full-time lifestyle content creator looking for a reliable video editor to help edit my daily vlogs and short-form social media content for Instagram Reels and other platforms.



My content is casual, personality-driven, day-in-the-life style content. I’m looking for someone who understands how to make everyday footage entertaining without making it feel overly produced.



Most videos will be created from raw clips I film throughout my day. I’ll upload the footage, and you’ll turn it into a finished short-form video that feels natural, fast-paced, and engaging.



What I’m looking for:



• Experience editing Instagram Reels, TikToks, daily vlogs, or similar creator content

• Strong sense of pacing and knowing which moments to keep or cut

• Clean cuts and transitions — nothing overly flashy or cheesy

• Ability to add text/captions when needed

• Good music selection and timing

• Ability to understand humor and leave in funny, candid, or imperfect moments that make the video feel real

• Comfortable following an established editing style rather than completely changing the feel of my content

• Reliable communication and quick turnaround

• Comfortable working with a large amount of raw footage

• Fluent enough in English to understand conversations, jokes, and context within the footage



I post consistently, so this has the potential to become an ongoing position with regular work. Ideally, I’d like to upload footage at the end of my day and have an edited draft ready for me to review the following morning.



I’m looking for someone who can learn my editing preferences over time so that very few revisions are eventually needed.

title: Applied AI Engineer – 3D Automation & Rendering
description:
JOB TITLE

Applied AI Engineer – 3D Automation & Rendering (Mac Required)



ABOUT THE JOB

We are looking for a talented AI Engineer who is passionate about artificial intelligence, automation, and emerging technologies.



Our goal is to use AI to dramatically simplify and automate the process of creating 3D models and realistic renderings from architectural floorplans and CAD files.



We work in the manufactured housing industry and have thousands of home designs that need to be converted into accurate 3D models with customizable materials, finishes, and options.



Today, much of this work is done manually. We want to change that.



IMPORTANT: We are NOT looking for a traditional CAD designer, 3D artist, or rendering specialist. We want a strong technical developer who can use AI, programming, and automation to eliminate as much manual work as possible.



This is an opportunity for someone who wants to become an expert in AI-powered 3D modeling and rendering while helping build something innovative.



WHAT YOU WILL DO

- Research and experiment with the latest AI tools for 3D modeling and rendering.

- Build automated systems that convert architectural plans and CAD files into accurate 3D models.

- Develop Python scripts, APIs, and automated workflows.

- Integrate AI models, computer vision, and open-source technologies.

- Use AI and procedural modeling to automate 3D geometry creation.

- Automate materials, textures, colors, and finishes.

- Develop systems for automatically generating realistic interior and exterior renderings.

- Automate configurable home options such as flooring, cabinets, countertops, appliances, siding, roofing, doors, and windows.

- Create automated processes for generating organized layers and assets for our interactive Product Builder.

- Build quality-control systems to identify errors and maintain consistency.

- Continuously test new technologies to make the entire process faster, easier, and more scalable.



REQUIRED SKILLS

- Strong Python programming and software development skills.

- Hands-on experience using AI models, AI APIs, and automation tools.

- Experience with generative AI, computer vision, or multimodal AI.

- Experience building automated workflows and connecting different software systems.

- Ability to research, evaluate, and implement new AI technologies.

- Experience using AI-assisted coding tools.

- Strong problem-solving and debugging skills.

- Ability to work independently and build solutions from scratch.

- Comfortable using Git, Terminal, and developer tools on macOS.



MAC REQUIREMENT

- Must own and use a Mac as your primary development computer.

- Must be comfortable working in a macOS development environment.

- Must be able to install, configure, and troubleshoot Python, AI development tools, Blender, and related software.

- Applicants using only Windows or Linux computers will not be considered.



BONUS SKILLS (NOT REQUIRED)

- Blender Python API

- AI-powered 3D generation

- Procedural modeling

- CAD, AutoCAD, Revit, or BIM

- 3D rendering automation

- GPU computing

- Image-to-3D or floorplan-to-3D technologies

- AI model integration and deployment



You do NOT need to be a professional 3D artist or CAD designer. We care much more about your programming abilities, AI knowledge, and ability to automate complicated processes.



WHAT WE ARE TRYING TO BUILD

Our current workflow:



CAD / Plans → 3D Home → Materials & Options → Renderings & Layered Assets → Product Builder



Our goal is to automate as much of this workflow as technically possible.



Ideally, we want to take an architectural floorplan or CAD file and automatically:

1. Interpret the architectural drawings.

2. Generate accurate 3D home geometry.

3. Apply materials, colors, and finishes.

4. Create configurable interior and exterior options.

5. Produce consistent, realistic renderings.

6. Generate organized layers and production-ready assets.

7. Export everything needed for our interactive Product Builder.



We understand that AI cannot perfectly automate every step today.



Your job is to research what's possible, experiment with different technologies, build prototypes, and create a production system that continually reduces the amount of manual work required. We are open to completely new approaches if they produce better results.



WHO WE ARE LOOKING FOR

We want someone who loves technology and figuring things out.



Someone who:

- Is genuinely excited about AI and follows emerging technologies.

- Enjoys experimenting with new tools and approaches.

- Has strong programming and technical problem-solving skills.

- Thinks about how to automate a task instead of doing it manually.

- Can take a challenging problem and independently research possible solutions.

- Is comfortable building prototypes, testing ideas, and learning from failures.

- Wants to become an expert in AI-powered 3D modeling and rendering.

- Is interested in building technology that could eventually scale across thousands of homes.



WHAT SUCCESS LOOKS LIKE

- We are not measuring success by how many 3D models you personally create.

- We are measuring success by how much of the modeling and rendering process you can automate.

- We want to build a repeatable system that makes each new home faster and easier to produce than the last.

- Our long-term goal is to create a highly automated production pipeline capable of generating thousands of accurate, configurable 3D homes with minimal manual involvement.



HOW TO APPLY

Please answer the following questions when applying:



1. What AI-powered tools, applications, or automation systems have you personally built? Please provide examples or links.



2. What experience do you have with Python, AI models, APIs, and AI-assisted coding tools?



3. If we gave you 1,000 architectural floorplans and asked you to automate the creation of accurate 3D homes and realistic renderings, how would you approach the problem?



4. What AI tools or technologies would you investigate first for automating 3D modeling and rendering?



5. What Mac do you currently use? Please include the model, chip (M1/M2/M3/M4/M5 or Intel), and RAM.



- We are not looking for someone to manually create 3D models.

- We are looking for someone who can use AI and technology to make the entire process dramatically easier.

- If you're a talented developer who loves AI, automation, and solving challenging technical problems, we'd love to hear from you.

title: Financial Accounting Coordinator
description:
About Eureka (Designa)



Eureka, LLC (Designa) is a growing California-based company with businesses spanning furniture, workspace solutions, and modular construction.



Our established brand, Eureka Ergonomic, designs and manufactures ergonomic furniture and workspace solutions for home, commercial, hospitality, residential, education, healthcare, and other environments. Our business brings together product design, research and development, manufacturing, logistics, sales, and customer support.



We are also expanding through Eureka Modular, a growing modular manufacturing business focused on innovative modular solutions and building systems.



Our headquarters in Corona, California, is a fast-paced, entrepreneurial environment where teams work closely across finance, operations, sales, product, manufacturing, and management.



As we grow, we are strengthening the financial systems and processes that support our businesses. This is an opportunity to join our team at an important stage of growth and contribute directly to building accurate, organized, and scalable financial operations.



About the Role



We are looking for a Financial Accounting Coordinator to support day-to-day accounting operations while taking an active role in sales tax compliance, vendor compliance, financial documentation, and coordination with external accounting professionals.



This is a hands-on position for someone who is accurate, organized, dependable, and comfortable following financial and tax-related processes from start to finish.



The role will primarily support Eureka Ergonomic, while also assisting with the financial and back-office setup of Eureka Modular as applicable.



The ideal candidate is someone who enjoys finding discrepancies, organizing information, following up on outstanding items, and making sure financial records and compliance documentation are complete and accurate.



Key Responsibilities



Accounting & Financial Operations



Maintain day-to-day bookkeeping, account coding, and financial records in QuickBooks Online

Reconcile bank and credit card accounts and investigate discrepancies

Organize invoices, receipts, payments, revenue, costs, and supporting documentation

Support monthly financial reporting and month-end close activities

Prepare organized financial information for management and external accounting professionals

Track outstanding accounting items, missing documentation, and required follow-ups

Maintain accurate, organized, and traceable financial records

Sales Tax & Tax Compliance



Maintain sales tax codes, rates, and jurisdictions in QuickBooks

Use Tax Cloud or similar sales tax automation software to support multi-state sales tax processes

Monitor state economic nexus thresholds and assist in identifying registration requirements

Assist with state sales tax permit registrations and related documentation

Review and maintain exemption and resale certificates

Support sales tax filing and compliance processes

Maintain complete and audit-ready sales tax documentation

Vendor & 1099 Compliance



Collect and maintain vendor W-9 documentation

Monitor vendor payments for 1099 reporting purposes

Support preparation and filing of 1099-NEC forms

Maintain organized vendor tax records and supporting documentation

Follow up with vendors regarding missing or incomplete documentation

CPA & Financial Coordination



Coordinate financial information between the company and external CPAs

Organize documentation required for tax filings, financial reviews, and compliance matters

Follow up with internal teams, vendors, and accounting professionals on outstanding items

Identify missing information, discrepancies, and overdue items

Communicate matters requiring management attention in a clear and timely manner

Provide organized financial information to support professional accounting and tax work

Cost & Business Operations Support



Track logistics, warehousing, delivery, labor, and third-party costs

Prepare monthly cost comparisons and identify significant discrepancies or exceptions

Organize supporting documentation for claims and chargebacks

Track vendor quotations and cost/service comparisons for management review

Support financial coordination across Eureka Ergonomic and Eureka Modular as needed

Documentation & Process Improvement



Maintain organized and accessible financial documentation

Maintain action lists for missing information and outstanding items

Follow up with responsible parties to obtain required financial information

Help document and improve repeatable financial workflows and procedures

Support the development of organized financial processes as the company grows

What We're Looking For



Required Qualifications



Experience with QuickBooks Online, including bookkeeping and account reconciliation

Experience with sales tax setup, reporting, or compliance

Experience with TaxCloud or a similar sales tax automation platform

Understanding of multi-state sales tax and economic nexus concepts

Familiarity with W-9 and 1099-NEC processes

Strong attention to detail and accuracy

Excellent organization and follow-through

Ability to identify discrepancies, missing information, and incomplete documentation

Strong written and verbal communication skills

Ability to communicate professionally with management, vendors, internal teams, and external accounting professionals

Ability to learn company-specific financial systems and processes quickly

Bilingual English/Mandarin Chinese Required

Preferred Qualifications



California sales tax or CDTFA experience

Multi-state sales tax registration or compliance experience

Practical experience monitoring economic nexus

Experience tracking logistics, warehousing, delivery, or third-party costs

Experience working in a growing or multi-business organization



What This Role Is



This is a hands-on accounting and financial coordination role with significant responsibility for maintaining accurate financial records and supporting sales tax and financial compliance processes.



You will work closely with company management, internal teams, vendors, and external CPAs and accounting professionals.



This position is focused on accurate execution, coordination, organization, follow-through, and reliable financial documentation. It is not a CPA sign-off position and does not independently provide tax or legal advice.



What We Offer



Health Insurance

Dental Insurance

Vision Insurance

401(k)

Paid Time Off

Paid Sick Leave

Growth and advancement opportunities

Opportunity to work across Eureka Ergonomic and Eureka Modular

Fast-paced, entrepreneurial work environment

Why Join Eureka?



At Eureka, your work will directly support the company's financial operations and continued growth.



You will work across departments and have the opportunity to build practical experience in accounting, sales tax compliance, financial operations, vendor management, and business processes.



If you are someone who values accuracy, accountability, organization, problem-solving, and continuous learning, we would like to hear from you.



Apply today to join Eureka, LLC in Corona, California.

The websites already exist. Your job is to capture them properly and make the work look its best.



These assets will be used on my agency website, social media and in sales presentations. They need to feel professional, considered and visually impressive.



What you’ll do



• Take high-resolution screenshots and screen recordings of websites I provide. Like I have started in here: [

You’ll need to check captures carefully for cookie banners, loading issues, missing images and awkward crops. The finished work should be ready to use without me having to spot and fix basic mistakes.

title: Application Specialist
description:
Position Overview: 



The Application Specialist is responsible for testing, troubleshooting, and updating the internal apps, automations, and workflows Power Plus Systems develops, making sure each one is reliable, easy to use, and ready for rollout. This role works closely with the Operations Manager and Data Specialist, partners with the Process Specialist to make sure every new application or update process is documented before rollout, and collaborates with Admin Operations, Scheduling, Finance, Estimating, and Field teams to find issues before team members do and turn feedback into improvements. The ideal candidate has a software development background, hands-on experience using Claude and other AI tools, a working knowledge of webhooks and integrations, and a strong eye for user interface and user experience design. 



Pay Range: $8 per hour based on experience with a performance review scheduled after 90 days of employment. We believe in rewarding exceptional talents. 





About Power Plus Systems: 



Power Plus Systems LLC has been a dominant force in the residential electrical contracting industry for two decades, and we continue to lead the way. Our vision is to successfully wire 28,000 homes to completion by the year 2029, ensuring safe and efficient electrical solutions, thereby making a positive impact on the lives of our customers and communities. At Power Plus Systems, LLC, a position with us isn't just a job; it's an opportunity to grow and develop within a company that genuinely appreciates your contributions and dedication to our shared mission. 





Objectives: 



- Test company apps, automations, and workflows before rollout to confirm they work as intended across devices, browsers, and real-world scenarios.

- Perform manual testing and support automated testing to catch bugs, broken logic, and edge cases early. 

- Troubleshoot issues reported by team members, identify the root cause, and coordinate fixes with the Operations Manager and Data Specialist. 

- Test and monitor webhooks and integrations between systems such as GoHighLevel, Make, 
, Claude, Jotform, and other company platforms to ensure data passes correctly. 

- Review apps from the user's point of view and recommend and implement UI and UX improvements that make tools easier, faster, and clearer for team members. 

- Use Claude and other AI tools to speed up test case creation, debugging, documentation, and app updates. 

- Apply approved updates and improvements to existing apps and workflows, then retest to confirm nothing else broke. 

- Work with the Process Specialist to make sure every new application or update process is documented before rollout, and maintain test checklists and release notes so every rollout is consistent and repeatable. 





Competencies: 



- Solid understanding of software development concepts, including front-end and back-end logic, APIs, and how data moves between systems. 

- Hands-on experience using Claude and other AI tools in daily work, with the judgment to verify AI output before relying on it. 

- Working knowledge of webhooks, including how to read payloads, interpret response codes, and troubleshoot failed connections. 

- Familiarity with manual and automated testing methods, test cases, and regression testing for apps and workflows. 

- Strong eye for design with a clear understanding of user interface (UI) and user experience (UX) principles. 

- Analytical, detail-oriented approach to finding root causes rather than surface-level fixes. 

- Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to explain technical issues to non-technical team members. 

- Ability to manage multiple testing and update projects at once while meeting rollout deadlines. 

- Comfort using browser developer tools and automation platforms such as Make or Zapier is a plus. 

- Construction, electrical, or trade-industry experience is a plus. 





Education and Experience: 



- Background in software development through a degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or a related field, or equivalent hands-on experience. 

- At least 2 years of experience in software development, QA testing, application support, or a related role. 

- Experience testing web apps, mobile apps, or automated workflows before release. 

- Experience working with webhooks, APIs, or system integrations. 

- Proven experience using Claude or other AI tools in a professional setting. 

- Experience with UI/UX design, design reviews, or tools such as Figma is a plus. 

- Experience with GoHighLevel, Make, 
, Claude, or similar business platforms is a plus. 





Equipment Requirements: 



- Computer or laptop capable of running multiple browsers, testing tools, and collaboration platforms at the same time. 

- Smartphone for testing mobile versions of company apps. 

- Stable and reliable internet connection for online operations and virtual communication. 





Physical Requirements: 



- Extended periods of sitting at a desk and working on a computer.

- Growth opportunities in a well-established company. 

- Ongoing training and professional development opportunities.

If you are ready to join Power Plus Systems, LLC, a well-established residential electrical contractor that values its team members and offers excellent benefits, please submit your application through the link below.

title: Client Intake & Client Success Specialist
description:
Client Intake & Client Success Specialist

Full-Time  | Remote | 9AM-5PM EST



We are hiring a highly responsive and organized Client Intake & Client Success Specialist

to support a fast-growing Canadian law firm. You will be the first point of contact for prospective clients and will play a key role  in making sure every inquiry is responded to quickly, properly assessed, documented, followed up on, and moved through the intake process. This role is ideal for someone who is confident on the phone, empathetic with clients, highly organized, and comfortable working in a fast-paced environment where follow-up and responsiveness matter.



What You'll Do

• Respond promptly and professionally to new client inquiries by phone,
, and

other channels

• Conduct intake calls and gather relevant information from prospective clients

• Screen and qualify inquiries based on established criteria and workflows

• Schedule consultations and coordinate next steps

• Follow up consistently with prospective clients so qualified opportunities do not go cold

• Prepare client agreements and intake documentation accurately

• Track outstanding documents and signatures through completion

• Maintain accurate notes and records in the lead/client management system

• Coordinate smooth handoffs to internal team members

• Provide a professional, compassionate, and positive client experience

• Support client satisfaction initiatives, including requesting and responding to online reviews

• Track follow-ups, response times, conversion activity, and other intake metrics



What We're Looking For

• 2+ years of experience in client intake, customer service, sales, customer success, lead management, or a similar client facing role

• Excellent spoken and written English

• Strong and confident phone communication skills

• Excellent active listening and interpersonal skills

• Highly organized with strong follow-through

• Comfortable managing a high volume of inquiries, tasks, and deadlines

• Strong attention to detail when preparing documentation and recording client information

• Comfortable using CRM, lead management, scheduling, and other online systems

• Able to follow structured workflows while using good judgment

• Comfortable working with KPIs, response-time expectations, and accountability metrics

• Able to work independently in a fast-moving remote environment



Strong Advantages

Experience in any of the following is a strong asset:

• Law firms or legal services

• Insurance or claims

• Healthcare or medical services

• Financial or professional services

• High-volume inbound sales or lead qualification

• Preparing agreements, contracts, retainers, or other client-facing documents



Experience with personal injury matters is an advantage but not required. Training on intake criteria, processes, and systems will be provided.



You'll Be a Great Fit If You Are

• Responsive — you do not let calls, messages, or follow-ups sit unanswered

• Empathetic — you can communicate professionally with people who may be

stressed or dealing with difficult circumstances

• Accountable — you take ownership of your leads, follow-ups, documentation, and results

• Detail-Oriented — you understand that accuracy matters

• Decisive — you can follow established criteria and make sound intake decisions

• Process-Driven — you enjoy systems, workflows, and keeping things organized

• Persistent — you are comfortable following up multiple times when needed

• Growth-Minded — you enjoy working in a fast-growing organization that continuously improves



This Role May Not Be Right for You If

• You are uncomfortable speaking with clients regularly by phone

• You frequently need reminders to complete follow-ups

• You struggle to manage multiple conversations and priorities at once

• You prefer a slow-paced environment with limited accountability

• You dislike working with KPIs or structured processes

• You are uncomfortable having respectful but direct conversations with prospective clients who may not qualify



How to Apply

Please submit:

1. Your updated resume

2. A short audio or video introduction explaining your experience with client intake, customer

service, sales, or lead management

3. Start your application subject line with the word RESPONSIVE – Your Name

title: Social Media Video Editor & Content Researcher
description:
Social Media Video Editor & Content Researcher



Brand: Après-Ski Daily

Platforms: Instagram, TikTok &

Position: Part-Time ± 10 hours

Schedule: Flexible hours, as long as weekly deadlines are met



About Après-Ski Daily

Après-Ski Daily is an Alpine lifestyle and après-ski brand focused on the party scene across the European Alps.

We have built a community of 115,000+ followers across Instagram, 
 and
, generating 50 million views during the last winter season.

We are looking for a highly independent and creative video editor who understands the energy of après-ski, electronic music, festivals and party culture.

This is not a traditional editing role where someone simply receives footage and cuts it together. We are looking for someone who can independently find content, identify great moments and trends, and turn them into engaging short-form videos.

We do not have our own video footage at the moment, so you will be responsible for sourcing content and developing videos from start to finish.



Your Responsibilities

1. Content Research & Sourcing

• Independently find and collect suitable après-ski, skiing, snowboarding, festival and party footage from the European Alps (from posted content by existing venues across the Alps).

• Identify the best clips, moments and angles to create engaging videos.

• Build and maintain a consistent pipeline of suitable content without needing us to provide footage or ideas.



2. Video Editing

• Independently create 7 short-form videos per week for Instagram Reels, 
 and
 Reels.

• Edit high-energy videos focused on après-ski, parties, DJs, electronic music and Alpine nightlife.

• Use strong hooks, fast pacing, well-timed cuts, music synchronization and engaging storytelling.

• Add text overlays, captions and other editing elements where appropriate.

• Understand what makes party videos exciting, immersive and shareable.

• Maintain a consistent style that fits the Après-Ski Daily brand.



3. Publishing & Scheduling

• Submit completed videos for our review and implement feedback or requested changes.

• Schedule approved posts through Metricool.



4. Performance & Improvement

• Monitor video performance and identify which styles, hooks and formats work best.

• Use these insights to continuously improve the content.



What We Are Looking For

• Strong affinity with party video editing, especially après-ski, festivals, nightlife, DJ sets and electronic music.

• Experience editing short-form content for Instagram, 
 and
.

• A good understanding of viral video formats, hooks, pacing and audience retention.

• The ability to independently source suitable footage and turn it into complete videos.

• A creative eye for selecting exciting moments and combining clips into engaging edits.

• You do not need daily instructions to get things done.

title: Medical Office Assistant / Practice Coordinator
description:
This job is for a telemedicine practice based in the US. We blend conventional, integrative, and functional medicine to treat hormone and thyroid conditions, autoimmune disease, gut health, weight loss (including GLP-1 therapy), fertility preparation, and more. We serve patients in three states.  We're a cash-pay practice ( no insurance accepted ) with a small, close-knit patient base, and we care a lot about patients feeling looked after.



About the role

This is not a "wait to be told what to do" job.  The practitioner sees patients about 15 hours a week. During those hours you keep the day running smoothly. The rest of your time goes to the back end: following up, cleaning up, and making our systems simpler and faster. You'll work with significant independence and little day-to-day oversight. The owner will rely on you heavily. The right person treats the practice like their own: they spot problems, find solutions, follow through, and leave no task open-ended. We’re looking for someone to grow with our practice for years, not months. This is a long-term, stable position for the right person. If you’re looking for a short-term gig, this isn’t the right fit.



What you'll do

Patient communication

• Answer calls, texts,
s, and portal messages warmly and professionally, always identifying yourself and the practice

• Schedule new and follow-up visits across time zones (schedule runs on Central Time)

• Send same-day appointment reminders and handle cancellations and reschedules according to our policy

• Answer clerical patient questions (lab status, billing, supplements, test kits) and route clinical questions to Rachel



Billing and payments

• Collect payment for visits and cash-pay labs and verify cards on file

• Follow up on declined cards and outstanding balances until resolved

• Reconcile the monthly lab bill against patient payments and catch billing errors



Labs, orders, and coordination

• Enter lab orders (Labcorp, Quest) and specialty tests 

• Prepare and fax imaging orders and referral letters

• Complete prior authorizations using chart notes (CoverMyMeds) - this is not frequent

• Manage incoming faxes: file results, prior auths, records requests, and refill requests, and route them correctly

• Handle medical records requests and releases of information, following each through to completion

• Communicate with pharmacies, other providers' offices, imaging centers, labs, and company representatives



Back-end and operations

• Keep every follow-up task closed out with a clear outcome

• Manage the practice inbox and keep shared documents organized and up to date

• Prepare monthly social media and
 content using provided templates and Canva ( eventually)

• Improve our workflows. Identify bottlenecks, suggest fixes, update our procedures guide, and reduce repeated work



Who you are

• Self-starter. When there's downtime, you find the next most valuable thing to do.

• Problem solver. You come with "here's what I found and what I recommend," not just "what should I do?"

• Loop closer. You follow up until things are resolved. Nothing falls through the cracks.

• Clear, personal communicator. Patients get concise, accurate, human replies, not long generic ones.

• Detail-oriented with money and medical information. You double-check orders, codes, and charges.

• Discreet and trustworthy. You handle protected health and payment information with care.



Requirements

• 2+ years in a medical office, medical virtual assistant, or healthcare admin role

• Experience with EHR systems, prior authorizations, and lab ordering

• Excellent written and spoken English

• Reliable internet, a quiet workspace, and a computer suitable for HIPAA-compliant work

• Availability during core patient hours: Monday - Friday 9:30 AM to 3:30 PM Central Standard Time

• Ability to learn new software quickly



Nice to have: experience with, RingCentral, CoverMyMeds, Fullscript, Google Workspace, Canva; functional or integrative medicine background; medical billing/coding knowledge (CPT, ICD-10).



I am very interested in finding someone to work with me long term. When you apply tell me - Where do you see yourself in two years, and what would make you stay with one employer long-term?
